abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦关联行政数据及匹配堆叠双重差分设计，评估了GLP-1治疗对劳动力市场结果的因果影响。我们将索马鲁肽上市前两年内开始GLP-1治疗的患者，与四年后开始治疗的观察特征相似的患者进行比较。研究发现，GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少了17.3%。我们估算，GLP-1治疗启动带来的总财政收益约为每位就业者年劳动收入的1.3%至1.5%。在四年期间，我们未检测到对收入、劳动力参与率或就业状况具有统计显著性或经济意义显著的影响。
title: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
title_zh: GLP-1类药物对劳动力市场的影响

abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于，既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出了一种新颖的揭示偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。我们证明，通过比较福利变化与工资变化对DI参保率的影响，可以识别出保险价值。在加拿大实施我们的框架后，估计每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。
title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值

abstract: In this article, we assess the effect of the French disability benefits program on the employment of low‐skilled youth. Using the French Labour Force Survey, we exploit the age discontinuity in the program eligibility to instrument the effect of this allowance on employment. The results show that receipt of the French disability benefits program reduces the probability of employment for low‐skilled youth with disabilities. However, the effect differs markedly by gender: it is significantly higher for women, while no effect is detectable in men.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了法国残疾人福利计划对低技能青年就业的影响。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们借助该计划资格认定中的年龄断点，将此项津贴对就业的影响作为工具变量进行分析。结果表明，领取法国残疾人福利计划津贴会降低低技能残疾青年的就业概率。然而，该影响存在显著的性别差异：对女性的影响明显更高，而对男性则未发现显著影响。
title: Effects of disability benefits on the employment of low‐skilled youth: Evidence from France
title_zh: 残疾津贴对低技能青年就业的影响：来自法国的证据

abstract: Unique global data on 47,000 consumers across 47 countries representing 90% of world GDP reveal universal patterns in macroeconomic belief formation. Most consumers form beliefs based on local information sources (utility bills, shopping, and acquaintances) that provide signals not representative for the overall consumption bundle, so that seeking information leads to forming biased macroeconomic expectations. Distrust in governments and central banks, the producers of aggregate economic information, helps explain reliance on local sources and the lack of learning from aggregate realizations. Observed macroeconomic volatility fuels distrust. In the cross-section, we confirm that certain demographics correlate with expectation biases but mostly due to different sorting into information sources, rather than different processing of the same economic information. These globally established facts inform advances of theories of belief formation and the design of communication strategies as a macroeconomic policy tool.
abstract_zh: 覆盖全球47个国家、代表全球90%GDP的47,000名消费者的独特全球数据揭示了宏观经济信念形成的普遍模式。大多数消费者基于本地信息源（水电账单、购物经历及熟人）形成信念，这些信息源提供的信号无法代表整体消费组合，因此信息寻求反而导致形成有偏的宏观经济预期。对生产总体经济信息的政府与中央银行的不信任，有助于解释消费者依赖本地信息源以及未能从总体经济实现中学习的原因。观测到的宏观经济波动加剧了这种不信任。在横截面分析中，我们证实某些人口统计特征与预期偏差相关，但这主要源于不同群体对信息源的选择差异，而非对相同经济信息处理方式的差异。这些全球性实证发现为信念形成理论的发展以及作为宏观经济政策工具的沟通策略设计提供了依据。
title: Information and Macroeconomic Expectations: Global Evidence
title_zh: 信息与宏观经济预期：全球证据

abstract: This paper proposes a vector autoregression augmented with nonlinear factors that are modeled nonparametrically using regression trees. There are four main advantages of our model. First, modeling potential nonlinearities nonparametrically lessens the risk of misspecification. Second, the use of factor methods ensures that departures from linearity are modeled parsimoniously. In particular, they exhibit functional pooling where a small number of nonlinear factors are used to model common nonlinearities across variables. Third, Bayesian computation using MCMC is straightforward even in very high-dimensional models, allowing for efficient, equation-by-equation estimation, thus avoiding computational bottlenecks that arise in popular alternatives such as the time-varying parameter VAR. Fourth, existing methods for identifying structural economic shocks in linear factor models can be adapted for the nonlinear case in a straightforward fashion using our model. Exercises involving artificial and macroeconomic data illustrate the properties of our model and its usefulness for forecasting and structural economic analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种向量自回归模型，该模型通过回归树非参数化地引入了非线性因子。我们的模型有四大优势。第一，非参数化地建模潜在的非线性关系降低了模型设定错误的风险。第二，采用因子方法确保了非线性偏离被简约地建模。特别是，它们展现出功能汇集特性，即用少量非线性因子来刻画变量间共有的非线性特征。第三，即使在极高维模型中，利用MCMC的贝叶斯计算方法也直接可行，允许逐方程高效估计，从而避免了如时变参数VAR等流行替代方法中出现的计算瓶颈。第四，现有的线性因子模型中识别结构性经济冲击的方法，可以借助我们的模型直接适用于非线性情形。基于人工数据与宏观经济数据的实证分析展示了我们模型的性质及其在预测和结构性经济分析中的实用性。

abstract: Heterogeneity and endogeneity become increasingly common in statistical modeling and econometric practice. Threshold regression provides a simple yet flexible modeling strategy to account for heterogeneity. This paper studies estimation and inference for multi-threshold regression with endogenous regressors. We exploit a novel two-stage estimation procedure based on instrumental variables, which first identifies a set of possible threshold locations using the group LASSO estimation, and then refines the candidate set by a predetermined selection criterion. Given that the performance of the conventional information criteria is sensitive to the choice of the penalization factor, we develop a data-adaptive threshold-based cross-validation criterion incorporating an order-preserved sample-splitting strategy to determine the number of thresholds. Regarding inference, we develop test statistics to test for the presence of threshold effects and the existence of endogeneity, respectively. Numerical simulations and an application analyzing the threshold effects of 401(k) plans on wealth demonstrate the excellent finite sample performance of our methods. Finally, we develop a user-friendly R package MultiThreshold to implement the methodologies.
abstract_zh: 异质性和内生性在统计建模与计量经济学实践中日益普遍。阈值回归提供了一种简单而灵活的建模策略来处理异质性。本文研究了具有内生回归变量的多阈值回归的估计与推断问题。我们利用一种基于工具变量的新颖两阶段估计程序，该程序首先通过组LASSO估计识别一组可能的阈值位置，然后通过预定的选择准则对候选集进行精炼。鉴于传统信息准则的性能对惩罚因子的选择较为敏感，我们开发了一种数据自适应的基于阈值的交叉验证准则，结合保序样本分割策略来确定阈值数量。在推断方面，我们分别构建了检验统计量，用于检验阈值效应的存在性以及内生性的存在性。数值模拟和一项分析401(k)计划对财富阈值效应的应用展示了我们方法在有限样本下的优异表现。最后，我们开发了一个用户友好的R包MultiThreshold来实现这些方法。
title: Estimation and Inference for Multi-Threshold Regression with Endogeneity

abstract: We examine the effects of time-limited disclosure relief under the Jumpstart Our Business Startups (JOBS) Act of 2012. The Act grants newly public firms up to five years of exemptions, and our results suggest that the fixed duration of this relief, as much as its availability, shapes post-IPO behavior. Using an intention-to-treat design, we compare treated firms with smaller reporting companies whose exemptions are similar but carry no fixed expiry date. Equity issuance by treated firms increases significantly as the deadline nears while debt issuance declines, and cash reserves accumulate over the period. Capital expenditure increases relative to controls in the early post-IPO years, while R&D shows no differential response. As expiry approaches, the differential with the control group in internal investment weakens but cash-financed acquisitions accelerate. This shift in investment composition coincides with deteriorating operating performance and declining market valuations relative to IPO levels. Our post-expiry analysis reveals an abrupt reversal in acquisition activity upon transition to full disclosure while internal investment remains unchanged, supporting the argument that pre-expiry behavior was driven by the regulatory timeline rather than natural firm maturation. We conclude that the duration of regulatory relief is as important as its scope in shaping corporate behavior, and that time-limited exemptions from mandatory disclosure can induce anticipatory firm responses that work against the policy's intended objectives.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了2012年《创业企业扶助法案》（JOBS法案）下限期信息披露豁免的影响。该法案赋予新上市公司最长五年的豁免期，我们的结果表明，这一救济的固定期限与其可用性同样重要，共同塑造了上市后的企业行为。采用意向性治疗设计，我们将受处理公司与作为对照的小型报告公司进行比较，后者的豁免条件相似但无固定到期日。随着截止日期临近，受处理公司的股权发行显著增加，而债务发行减少，现金储备在此期间累积。在上市后初期，资本支出相对于对照组有所增加，而研发支出未表现出差异化反应。随着豁免期临近结束，与对照组相比，内部投资的差异减弱，但现金收购活动加速。这种投资构成的转变与经营业绩恶化和相对于IPO水平的市场估值下降同时发生。我们的豁免期后分析显示，在过渡至全面披露后，收购活动出现急剧逆转，而内部投资保持不变，这支持了豁免期前行为由监管时间表驱动而非企业自然成熟所致的论点。我们得出结论，监管救济的期限在塑造企业行为方面与其范围同等重要，且强制性披露的限期豁免可能引发预期性企业反应，从而违背政策预期目标。
title: How does relief from mandatory disclosure affect firm investment and growth?
title_zh: 强制性披露豁免如何影响企业投资与增长？

abstract: This study examines how passive institutional investors reshape corporate venture capital (CVC) investment decisions. We find that increases in passive institutional ownership lead firms to cut back CVC investments in non-core, high-risk, and low-quality ventures, with the reduction being more pronounced among firms subject to more severe managerial agency problems. Futhermore, the reduction of CVC investments leads to higher short-term announcement returns and improved long-term operating and innovation performance. The findings suggest that passive institutional investors mitigate managerial agency problems and improve innovation by disciplining CVC investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了被动机构投资者如何重塑企业风险投资（CVC）决策。我们发现，被动机构持股比例的增加促使企业削减对非核心、高风险及低质量项目的CVC投资，且这一削减效应在面临更严重管理层代理问题的企业中更为显著。此外，CVC投资的减少带来了更高的短期公告回报，并改善了长期运营与创新绩效。研究结果表明，被动机构投资者通过约束CVC投资决策，缓解了管理层代理问题并促进了创新。
title: Less is more: Institutional investors and corporate venture capital

abstract: Using longitudinal data from the UK, we study the role of industrial segregation for sexual identity-based pay disparities, while controlling for fixed unobserved heterogeneity. We show that industries that have a greater proportion of sexual minorities pay their male employees less. This is of an order of magnitude of a 0.6% marginal reduction in earnings as industrial representation of sexual minorities increases by 1 percent. This compares to an equivalent marginal figure for occupational segregation of approximately 0.9%. In contrast, there is a protective element present for females in the public sector who benefit from a within industry premium to locating in industries with greater LGB representation. However, such effects do not remove the substantial wage penalty faced by gay men, and by lesbian women in the private sector.
abstract_zh: 利用英国纵向数据，我们研究了行业隔离对基于性取向的薪酬差异的作用，同时控制了固定的不可观测异质性。我们表明，性少数群体占比更高的行业支付给男性员工的薪酬较低。当行业中的性少数群体代表性增加1%时，男性员工收入边际减少约0.6%。这与职业隔离的相应边际数值约0.9%相比。相反，在公共部门，女性存在一种保护性因素，她们因进入LGB代表性更高的行业而享有行业内溢价。然而，这些效应并未消除男同性恋者以及私营部门女同性恋者所面临的显著工资惩罚。

abstract: 农业生产的季节性深刻影响着劳动力配置与经济结构转型，但这一关键因素在既有研究和政策框架中尚未得到充分重视。本文构建两部门、两时期理论模型，分析农闲劳动力流动对非农扩张的影响，并基于清代《刑科题本》构建18—19世纪中国府级面板数据进行实证检验。研究发现：农业季节性总体上促进区域经济发展，机制在于农闲期释放的劳动力以佣工形式进入手工业和服务业，推动劳动力跨部门配置。进一步分析表明，较高的政府治理能力、较强的宗族组织以及良好的地方文教环境，有助于降低劳动力匹配与市场交易成本，促进季节性劳动力转化为生产性就业。空间异质性显示，在非农能力不足的地区，农业季节性可能导致失业增加，而在长江流域及南方地区，农闲劳动力更容易转化为非农就业。时间异质性表明，随着经济结构演进，农业季节性边际作用减弱。本文从农业时间结构视角补充了二元经济与内卷化讨论，也为理解乡村振兴中统筹农闲就业承接、农忙用工保障与县域产业发展关系提供了历史经验。

abstract: 在全方位扩大内需的政策背景下，家电国补政策成为政府短期提振消费的重要手段，同时也深刻影响着市场价格传导与行业竞争格局。本文基于Salop竞争框架构建多企业定价博弈模型，刻画消费补贴如何通过降低家电商品实际支付价格、扩大补贴期市场规模并强化企业间竞争，影响价格传导与财政乘数效应。基于手工整理的16000余条家电国补覆盖商品，结合家电商品价格、品牌销量和企业财务数据，本文综合评估了家电国补政策的价格传导与财政乘数效应。研究发现，家电国补政策后消费者购买参与商品的价格平均下降约22%，超出名义补贴上限（20%），且消费者获得了全部补贴红利，存在价格下行现象。价格下行并非补贴的直接结果，而是通过加剧家电企业间价格竞争造成的。集中度较低行业、价格未触顶商品及新上市商品的价格反应更强。同时，家电国补政策显著提升了品牌销量和企业盈利，也加速了市场向头部品牌集中。在量价联动的基础上，本文进一步分析了家电国补政策的财政乘数效应，发现每1元财政补贴可带来1.2元—2.3元的消费增量。本文为进一步优化消费补贴政策设计，更好发挥扩大内需战略支点作用提供重要政策启示。

abstract: 传统生产力及其发展范式无法全面实现人与自然和谐共生，全面推进中国式现代化需要全新的能源体制和工业模式。新质生产力的提出，从结构视角破解了这一难题，在统筹全面绿色转型与经济增长的同时，提供了从工业文明向生态文明转型的理论证成和实践指引，其根本宗旨在于引导建立“人、自然、生产力”三者之间的良性循环系统和持续正向反馈机制，孕育形成生态文明的内核。基于新质生产力的支撑，一个将自然资本收益内生化，以人的福祉为目标的发展范式将重塑人类文明。更进一步，论文阐释了新质生产力推动全面绿色转型，构建生态文明的理论逻辑与方法论基础，在此基础上提出“宏观体制机制改革—中观产业结构跃升—微观技术创新”的实践进路。毫无疑问，新质生产力理论是马克思主义生产力理论的巨大创新，是中国经济学自主知识体系的重要组成部分。

abstract: 产业政策对实现国家技术主权与保障经济安全至关重要。本文基于企业微观行为视角，在分析企业创新“行为约束”的基础上，构建了一个内生化行为偏差的异质性创新模型，揭示阻碍企业技术跃迁的深层微观机制，探究中国产业政策如何助力企业技术突破。研究发现，企业技术突破存在一个由“渐进改良转向突破式创新”和“突破式创新回归保守策略”两个临界点所构成的创新窗口期，而中国产业政策正是通过托底型助推和激励型助推拓展了这一窗口期，从而助力企业进行持续性技术突破探索。以“制造强国战略”为准自然实验的实证研究亦证实了这一机制。本文结论不仅为揭示中国产业政策成功之谜提供了一个企业微观行为分析框架，更为产业政策有效缓解企业行为约束，进而通过“行为助推”系统地引导和释放企业创新潜能提供政策启示。

abstract: 当前，“内卷式”竞争正成为抑制企业创新活力、阻滞产业高质量跃迁的关键问题。本文聚焦中国制造业产业链层面“内卷式”竞争的形成机制与治理路径，通过构建链主企业、供应商与消费者的三方动态博弈模型，揭示纵向博弈与横向竞争双重作用下“内卷式”竞争产生的微观机理。研究发现，链主企业虽然对于产业链稳定和技术创新有一定积极作用，但若放任其在产业链中的主导性持续强化，可能引发三种负面效应：（1）产业链低端锁定效应，形成长期“低质量、低价格、低利润”的均衡陷阱；（2）利益分配失衡，产业链利润分配呈现“马太效应”，中小微企业利润空间收窄；（3）政策传导低效，产业补贴存在“截留效应”，大部分补贴转移至链主企业。基于价值链治理与制度变迁理论，本文提出“行业协会协同治理+渐进式质量标准演进”的双轨治理路径：一方面，通过多中心治理结构降低单边依赖度；另一方面，通过设定动态质量标准引导产品质量升级。本研究将产业链治理从“有效市场+有为政府”的二元范式拓展至包含行业自组织与质量标准引领的多元框架，为综合整治“内卷式”竞争提供了理论支撑与可操作路径。

abstract: 技术标准国际对接是我国主动融入全球创新网络，实现以开放促创新的高水平制度型开放举措。本文通过自然语言处理方法测度专利文本与采标技术标准文本相似度，识别企业受技术标准国际对接的影响程度，结合高维固定效应模型实证检验技术标准国际对接对企业国际创新合作的影响。研究发现，技术标准国际对接通过降低跨国技术协调成本、契约风险成本以及贸易摩擦引致的不确定性冲击，显著提升企业国际创新合作水平。但技术标准国际对接并未有效反哺国内创新，原因在于当前我国融入全球创新网络过程中技术标准对接模式的不匹配。以国际合作专利成果署名顺序为切入点的研究发现，完全等同、等效采用国际标准虽能更有效提高我国企业国际合作创新水平，但对其创新主导能力的提升有限；而采用与中国技术发展阶段更匹配的修改后采标方式进行标准对接，能有效提升国内企业国际创新合作主导能力，提高企业创新质量、突破企业自身创新边界、扩大企业创新国际影响力。基于企业创新相对基础差异的深入分析发现，创新基础较弱的企业盲目追求标准一致性是导致技术标准国际对接难以反哺国内创新的关键。本研究从标准制度型开放视角，为我国充分利用全球创新资源、实现科技创新自立自强提供了现实方案和经验证据。

abstract: 2017—2019年，为反制美国对华加征的关税，中国对来自美国的进口产品实施了反制性关税措施，同时主动降低了对其他贸易伙伴的进口关税。本文基于包含最终品与中间投入品的非位似嵌套常替代弹性需求系统，结合丰富的家庭消费支出数据、贸易数据与关税数据，量化评估了这一非对称关税调整对中国城镇家庭消费者福利的总体影响及其分配效应。研究发现：（1）对美反制关税对单个家庭带来的消费者福利损失总体温和可控，约占家庭支出的0.11%。（2）对其他国家降低关税使家庭消费者福利平均上升0.08%，很大程度上抵消了反制关税带来的负面冲击。（3）非对称关税调整促使进口来源地从美国转向其他国家，降低了家庭对美国进口的依赖程度，从而进一步削弱了反制关税对消费者福利的不利影响。（4）从分配效应来看，由于低收入家庭消费了更多可贸易品，尤其是受反制关税影响较大的食品与农产品，因此加征关税对低收入群体的影响略大；而对其他国家调降关税则未带来明显的福利分配效应。本文从家庭消费者福利的视角，为近年来我国贸易政策调整的经济效应提供了定量评估，并表明扩大自主开放、促进进口来源地多元化，有助于缓解中美贸易摩擦对我国经济的冲击。

abstract: 近年来，持续演化的贸易冲击对中国劳动力市场产生了复杂而深远的影响。关税频繁变动对劳动力市场的影响不仅关系到就业总量稳定，也关系到岗位结构与技能配置的再平衡，是高质量就业发展进程中不可忽视的外部变量。本文基于国内主流招聘平台岗位微观数据，创新性地融合大语言模型与自然语言处理技术，系统识别了美国加征关税对中国城市劳动力需求规模、岗位结构和技能配置的多重影响，并厘清其影响路径和异质性。研究发现，外部加征关税显著抑制了城市线上招聘总量，这一影响主要作用于扩展边际，即招聘企业数量缩减，而非集约边际下企业平均招聘强度下滑。进一步结合工商注册企业数据与企业微观财务数据的分析表明：扩展边际的收缩特征主要体现为企业暂时停止招聘，而非退出市场；贸易冲击推升企业成本并压缩盈利，从而导致企业暂停招聘。异质性分析显示，冲击对低学历、低经验及常规体力技能相关岗位的抑制更强；贸易多元化程度更高、政策环境更稳定的城市表现出更强的就业韧性。本文的研究从数量、结构和技能视角厘清了贸易冲击对中国劳动力市场带来的多重影响，为稳主体、促多元化与促进劳动力转型的政策制定提供实证支撑，也为推动实现高质量充分就业提供经验启示。

abstract: 财政紧平衡背景下，如何提高财政支出效率、提升财政支撑现代化建设的能力成为备受关注的话题。数字技术应用正在引领国家治理方式变革，但其能否在提升财政支出效率中发挥积极作用，仍有待深入探讨。本文依托预算管理一体化这一财政管理数字化的核心工程，利用2016—2022年的地级市面板数据，实证分析了数字技术应用对财政支出效率的影响。研究发现，一体化系统上线显著提高了地方财政支出效率；其中，提高预算过程管理效能、优化预算资源配置是预算管理一体化促进支出效率提高的重要机制。异质性分析显示，预算管理一体化的作用在政府规模较大、财政自主权较高、前期财政支出效率较低的城市中更强。最后，本文未能发现预算管理一体化对缓解财政压力有显著作用，这意味着本文发现的效率提升，更多来自产出端的改进，并没有破除支出扩张冲动与促进增收。本文为评估数字技术促进国家治理的成效提供了来自财政领域的证据，对进一步健全现代预算制度有所启示。

abstract: We estimate the spillovers of demand- and supply-driven shocks in China to foreign countries and firms. We combine a Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) framework with a broad-based measure of domestic economic activity in China and narrative evidence on domestic shocks to distinguish supply versus demand components of Chinese growth. We then assess the responses to such shocks of GDP (revenue) in other countries (firms). The results suggest that: (i) global GDP responds more to Chinese supply shocks than to Chinese demand shocks; (ii) both supply and demand slowdowns in China are followed by declines in partner country GDP and firm revenue, especially in countries and firms with stronger trade linkages to China; and (iii) Chinese supply shocks have larger impacts on countries and firms with relatively stronger input linkages to China, while Chinese demand shocks have larger impacts on countries and firms with relatively stronger output linkages to China.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了中国需求驱动与供给驱动冲击对国外国家及企业的溢出效应。我们将结构向量自回归（SVAR）框架与中国国内经济活动的广泛衡量指标相结合，并利用国内冲击的叙事证据，以区分中国经济增长中的供给与需求成分。随后，我们评估了这些冲击对其他国家和企业GDP（收入）的影响。结果表明：（i）全球GDP对中国供给冲击的反应大于对中国需求冲击的反应；（ii）中国供给与需求的双重放缓均伴随着伙伴国GDP及企业收入的下降，尤其是在与中国贸易联系较强的国家和企业中；（iii）中国供给冲击对与中国投入联系相对较强的国家和企业影响更大，而中国需求冲击则对与中国产出联系相对较强的国家和企业影响更大。

abstract: We study the short-run macroeconomic transmission of a US–China tariff war in an open economy multi-sector New Keynesian model with input–output linkages, sectoral nominal rigidities, and heterogeneous currency invoicing. A reciprocal 10 percentage-point tariff increase generates asymmetric incidence: the tariff-imposing country bears more of the inflationary burden, while the targeted country experiences the larger output contraction. Production networks amplify this contraction by propagating the shock beyond the directly tariffed bilateral margin. Currency invoicing further shapes transmission. Under heterogeneous invoicing, dollar-priced border prices weaken the expenditure-switching role of exchange rates, deepening the contraction in China relative to producer-currency pricing and altering third-country spillovers. The EA response is small in the aggregate, but only because positive trade-diversion margins are offset by weaker demand from China and multilateral adjustments. We then exploit the model’s sectoral structure by imposing tariffs on one Chinese sector at a time. Sectoral incidence is highly concentrated, but aggregate effects cannot be inferred from the directly tariffed sector alone: domestic propagation offsets own-sector gains in the US, reinforces own-sector losses in China, and leaves the EA as a net object shaped by opposing trade margins. The results show that tariff incidence depends jointly on where the tariff lands, how the shock propagates through production networks, and how invoicing governs border-price adjustment. A framework that combines these margins delivers a materially different assessment from one built on bilateral trade shares alone. JEL Classification: E31, E32, E52, F13, F41, F42
abstract_zh: 我们研究中美关税战在开放经济多部门新凯恩斯模型中的短期宏观经济传导，该模型包含投入产出关联、部门名义刚性和异质性货币计价。互征10个百分点关税会产生不对称的归宿效应：征收关税的国家承担更多通胀压力，而目标国家则经历更大的产出收缩。生产网络通过将冲击传播至直接受关税影响的双边边际之外，放大了这种收缩。货币计价进一步塑造了传导机制。在异质性计价下，美元计价的边境价格削弱了汇率的支出转换作用，相较于生产者货币计价，加深了中国的产出收缩，并改变了第三国的溢出效应。欧元区的总体反应较小，但这仅仅是因为正向的贸易转移边际被来自中国的需求减弱和多边调整所抵消。随后，我们利用模型的部门结构，逐一对中国单个部门征收关税。部门层面的归宿高度集中，但总体效应无法仅从直接受关税影响的部门推断：国内传播抵消了美国本部门的收益，强化了中国本部门的损失，并使欧元区成为由相反贸易边际塑造的净对象。结果表明，关税归宿共同取决于关税落点、冲击通过生产网络的传播方式，以及计价机制如何主导边境价格调整。一个综合这些边际的框架得出的评估，与仅基于双边贸易份额的框架存在实质性差异。JEL分类号：E31, E32, E52, F13, F41, F42

abstract: We construct city-year measures of AI labor demand from 1.6 million online job postings between 2016 and 2024, and merge them with nationally representative microdata from the China Family Panel Studies (2016-2022). Fixed-effects estimates show that local AI labor demand has positive impacts on individual wages: a one-unit increase in AI demand (1,000 postings, firms, or job titles) raises wages by about 0.2-0.3 percent. Women experience stronger gains-about 0.5-0.7 percent per unit increase-while men show no measurable effect. Wage effects are largest in Western provinces, and in China's major AI-cluster cities where complementary production factors and digital infrastructure are most developed. Occupational analyses further show that women's gains are concentrated in service-oriented, less skill-intensive jobs where AI complements interpersonal and coordination tasks rather than substituting them. Overall, AI diffusion generates meaningful but unequal labor market spillovers, with wage gains concentrated among women, dynamic regions, and human-AI complementary occupations, underscoring both the opportunities of technological transformation and the challenges of achieving inclusive growth.

abstract: This paper examines the economic origins and consequences of anti-missionary violence during the late Qing China (1860-1911). Using newly digitized data, we find that conflicts were attenuated by economic complementarities - such as access to Treaty Ports and public goods - rather than triggered by religious competition with Confucian elites. On the consequences part, we document negative economic spillovers of anti-missionary conflicts, through reduced foreign and domestic investments in modern firms and banks. These negative outcomes were reinforced by Western media coverage and persist today through lower FDI flows and increased autarkic attitudes among residents.

abstract: We study how the end of the quota system for textiles and clothing products in the American and European markets on January 1, 2005, affected China's exports to third countries, where policy was unchanged. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the number of Chinese firms exporting previously restricted products to third countries increased sharply after quota removal. The expansion involved many private firms that exported to neither US-EU markets before nor after 2005. This indicates that the policy shock enhanced China's role as an export base. Conversely, protectionist shifts in large economies would likely generate sizeable negative third-market effects.

abstract: This paper revisits the old thesis of the contrasting paths of modernization between Japan and China. It develops a new analytical framework regarding the role of knowledge acquisition (propositional vs. prescriptive) and political centralization as the key drivers behind these contrasting paths. Our model and historical data highlight how the introduction of these elements contributed to Meiji Japan's decisive turn towards the West and Qing China's lethargic response to Western imperialism. Our analytical framework, developed from a comparative historical narrative and quantitative data, sheds new insights onto the importance of knowledge acquisition for enabling developing countries to reach the world's economic frontier.

abstract: We introduce a methodology to measure cross-country trends in innovation capability- "technological trajectoriesâ€ and implement this on a new rich dataset covering patents between 1836 and 2016 across multiple countries. Intuitively, trajectories are revealed by a country's sustained increases in patenting across multiple patent offices. We first describe the data patterns, showing the relative decline of the UK, and the rise first of the US and Germany, and then later of Japan and China. We then econometrically estimate trajectories on (i) the post-1902 period for France, Germany, Japan, the UK and US, and (ii) the post-1960 period for a wider sample of 40 countries. Our trajectories are strongly positively correlated with Total Factor Productivity growth, and also (but less strongly) associated with the growth of labour productivity and capital intensity. We show that future trajectories are predicted by a country's initial levels of R&D, education and defence spending, classic drivers of innovation in modern growth theory.

abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China's share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的一个核心洞见是，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进。它为各国整体带来相互的总体福利增益，但在国家内部则产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术的一种税收，扭曲了国内消费者和生产者所面对的价格。大国可以利用关税来改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利更低。关税可用于在国内贸易的赢家和输家之间重新分配收入，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全的理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常合理化针对这些产业的定向政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预所超越。近期美国关税浪潮的实证发现表明，这些关税的大部分负担由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这一重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国。

abstract: We study how internal hierarchies affect productivity, wages, and labor shares in Chinese manufacturing firms. Using detailed information on professional titles from the 2004 Annual Survey of Industrial Production, we construct firm-level measures of hierarchical structure and compare private firms with state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Private firms operate leaner hierarchies and exhibit rising labor productivity as organizational layers expand. In contrast, SOEs adopt prematurely deep and top-heavy hierarchies associated with declining labor productivity but higher wages. As a result, labor shares are substantially higher in SOEs. Counterfactual exercises show that distortions in hiring and organizational design account for a large fraction of the labor share gap between SOEs and private firms, pointing to inefficient internal organization as an important source of aggregate misallocation.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了内部层级结构如何影响中国制造业企业的生产率、工资及劳动份额。利用2004年工业年度调查中关于专业职称的详细数据，我们构建了企业层面的层级结构指标，并对私营企业与国有企业进行了比较。私营企业采用更为精简的层级结构，随着组织层级的增加，劳动生产率呈上升趋势。相反，国有企业过早地形成了深且头重脚轻的层级结构，这与劳动生产率下降但工资水平较高相关联。因此，国有企业的劳动份额显著更高。反事实分析表明，招聘和组织设计中的扭曲解释了国有企业与私营企业之间劳动份额差距的很大一部分，指出低效的内部组织是总体资源错配的重要来源。

abstract: This paper evaluates the usefulness of crowd-sourced Chinese genealogical data for quantitative research in demography and economic history. I first examine whether genealogies - despite well-known selection biases - produce demographic patterns consistent with established historical knowledge of China. Comparisons with existing studies show that aggregate population-growth trends and sex ratios over time align reasonably well with established demographic and historical findings, suggesting that genealogies, though selective, capture coherent and interpretable patterns. Building on these plausibility checks, the paper argues that the main value of genealogical data lies in their scalability and temporal depth, particularly as crowd-sourced digitization vastly expands the number of available records. These features make genealogies well suited to analyses that leverage variation across regions and over time, an approach that is central in modern economic history.

abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the health-status gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
abstract_zh: 我们利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，探讨了健康状况与社会地位之间的关系。这些数据覆盖了广泛的人口群体，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存相关，还跨越家庭和世代产生影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的平均寿命为52岁，但差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高出22%，从而享有七年的寿命优势。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关联。高地位男性的妻子相较于平民妻子的寿命优势超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于最高地位群体，而所有地位层级间的健康-地位梯度则在18世纪显现。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等是富有成效的。

abstract: Competition between the United States and China is likely to shape the course of history in the coming years. Does foreign aid constitute an arena of confrontation? Using the OECD Creditor Reporting System and the Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset, we study the relationship between the aid-commitment strategies of Beijing and Washington. Employing an instrumental variables approach, we find that the United States increases its aid commitments in recipient countries where China commits more funds. The effect is stronger when the United States has close political or commercial ties with the recipient country and is larger in years of heightened US–China political disagreement. These findings are consistent with a framework in which the two countries compete to acquire influence over the recipient countries.
abstract_zh: 美国与中国之间的竞争很可能在未来数年塑造历史进程。对外援助是否构成对抗的一个领域？利用经合组织债权人报告系统及全球中国发展融资数据集，我们研究了北京与华盛顿的援助承诺策略之间的关系。采用工具变量方法，我们发现美国在中国承诺更多资金援助的受援国增加了其援助承诺。当美国与受援国存在紧密的政治或商业联系时，这一效应更为显著，且在美中政治分歧加剧的年份里影响更大。这些发现与两国竞相获取对受援国影响力的框架相吻合。

abstract: U.S. policy increasingly seeks to slow China's technological rise by restricting its access to American science, on the assumption that Chinese innovation depends on U.S. science. Linking the full corpus of Chinese invention patents to the global scientific literature, we show that this dependence has fallen in recent years: the share of the China-produced science behind Chinese patents rose from 1% in 2000 to 26% in 2025, overtaking the U.S. share in 2021. As China's reliance on U.S.-produced science fades, policies restricting access fall out of alignment with the U.S.' actual strategic position.
abstract_zh: 美国政策日益试图通过限制中国获取美国科学成果来减缓其技术崛起，其前提假设是中国创新依赖于美国科学。通过将中国发明专利的完整语料库与全球科学文献相链接，我们表明这种依赖性近年来已有所下降：中国专利背后由中国产出的科学所占份额从2000年的1%上升至2025年的26%，并于2021年超过了美国所占份额。随着中国对美国产出的科学依赖逐渐减弱，限制获取的政策与美国实际战略地位已不再相符。

abstract: Bipartisan doubts about the value of liberal trade in the US are shared by many populist European parties, who also question the value of deeper international economic integration. Yet for all the skeptical rhetoric-and real steps from the US and other advanced economies-globalization is not in retreat. Global trade continues to rise alongside global economic growth. If anything, trade has picked up since the pandemic. Widespread expectations that the global economy would fragment into rival blocks have not yet come to pass. Global flows related to corporate tax avoidance remain significant, cutting into US fiscal revenues. China's increasingly troubled domestic economy and its large-scale industrial policies risk leaving the US and its allies more, not less, reliant on Chinese supply in key sectors. The recent surge in China's trade surplus is evidence of ongoing globalization, and China's continued reliance on the world's big democracies for demand runs counter to any coherent definition of fragmentation. But increased global reliance on China for supply emerges more from China's own economic imbalances than from a healthy global division of labor. There is thus scope for policy reforms that support a healthier form of integration: notably, ending the perverse incentives in the US tax codes that undermine US production and revenues and harmonizing clean industrial policies to deepen trade among allies.
abstract_zh: 美国两党对自由贸易价值的质疑，与许多欧洲民粹主义政党的观点不谋而合，后者同样对深化国际经济一体化的意义提出疑问。然而，尽管存在种种怀疑论调——以及美国及其他发达经济体采取的实际措施——全球化并未退潮。全球贸易持续随经济增长而攀升。若说有何变化，疫情后贸易反而有所加速。关于全球经济将分裂为对立集团的普遍预期尚未成为现实。与企业避税相关的全球资金流动依然庞大，侵蚀着美国的财政收入。中国国内经济日益面临的困境及其大规模产业政策，可能使美国及其盟友在关键领域对中国供应的依赖不减反增。近期中国贸易顺差的激增，正是全球化持续进行的体现，而中国对世界主要民主国家市场的持续依赖，与任何关于“碎片化”的严谨定义背道而驰。然而，全球对中国供应的依赖增强，更多源于中国自身的经济失衡，而非健康的全球分工。因此，政策改革存在空间，以支持一种更为健康的整合形式：尤为重要的是，消除美国税法中损害本国生产与财政收入的扭曲激励，并协调清洁产业政策，以深化盟友间的贸易往来。

abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的指标来衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场，据此估算了一项政策规则，该规则兼顾了其价格稳定任务的双重性质——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——以及其操作框架的演变。内部传导遵循教科书模式，但因人民币的积极管理和金融账户而存在例外。外部溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应显著。金融溢出效应为二阶性质，主要源自贸易溢出。

abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中大多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正的屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险并不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利往往设有较低的年度限额。我们研究了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响，这一人群视力损伤、患病率和残疾率较高。利用2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据及双重差分设计，我们估计医疗补助常规视力福利增加了过去一年的眼科检查、眼镜购买及医疗补助在眼镜上的支出，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现了对医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出溢出效应的提示性证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使拥有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保者额外购买眼镜相一致，尽管估计值较为温和。
title: When Medicaid Pays the Bill: Routine Vision Benefits, Eye Care Use, and Eyeglasses Spending Among Dual-eligible Medicare Enrollees

abstract: We estimate the association between high-stakes exams and student suicides in India using geocoded, high-frequency media data. Student suicides rise by 17.5 percent during NEET-UG or JEE-Mains exam months, with no comparable pattern around lower-stakes board exams or among adults. Stronger associations are seen among girls. Associations being higher in high-participation states, urbanised districts, and in months when high-stakes and board exams coincide suggest that peer pressure and economic incentives in highly competitive environments may worsen mental health. Using cyclone and election months as potential drivers of media attention, we rule out media bias driving our results. Event-study estimates show suicides concentrating in months before and during exams, with a weaker association around result announcements. While falsification exercises strengthen our findings, Oster Bounds analysis addresses potential omitted variable bias. Lacking granular mental health data, we generate an alternative database to address a key policy question that can spur future research.
abstract_zh: 我们利用地理编码的高频媒体数据，估算了印度高风险考试与学生自杀之间的关联。在NEET-UG或JEE-Mains考试月份，学生自杀率上升17.5%，而低风险委员会考试期间或成年人中未观察到类似模式。女孩中关联性更强。在高参与度邦、城市化地区以及高风险考试与委员会考试重合的月份，关联性更高，这表明高度竞争环境中的同伴压力和经济激励可能加剧心理健康问题。利用气旋和选举月份作为媒体关注的潜在驱动因素，我们排除了媒体偏见对结果的影响。事件研究估计显示，自杀集中在考试前和考试期间，而成绩公布前后的关联较弱。尽管证伪检验增强了我们的发现，Oster边界分析处理了潜在的遗漏变量偏差。鉴于缺乏细粒度心理健康数据，我们构建了一个替代数据库，以解决一个可激发未来研究的关键政策问题。

abstract: Using diaries covering 25-61-year-olds in the American Time Use Survey 2009-24, this study demonstrates that temporal variety—doing more different things in a day—is income superior. Linking these data to underlying Current Population Surveys, propensity-score models show that people stating that they have a mobility/physical disability in each of two consecutive annual surveys undertake almost 4 percent fewer activities per day than other, demographically identical individuals. They also earn about 50 percent less. Combining the estimated impact of income on temporal variety with the implied reductions in variety incurred by those with the disability yields a monetary equivalent of lost variety exceeding that of lost earnings. Measuring disability status only once yields much smaller estimated shortfalls in temporal variety and earnings. That suggests that one-time self-reports of disabilities, which underlie the bulk of studies on the impacts of disabilities on earnings, also underestimate long-term effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009-24年美国时间使用调查中25-61岁人群的日记数据，证明时间多样性——即一天中从事更多不同活动——属于收入优越品。将这些数据与基础的人口现状调查相链接，倾向得分模型显示，在连续两次年度调查中均报告有行动/身体残疾的人群，其每日活动数量比人口统计学特征相同的其他人群少近4%。他们的收入也低约50%。将收入对时间多样性的估计影响与残疾人士所承受的多样性减少相结合，得出的多样性损失货币等值超过了收入损失。仅测量一次残疾状态所估计的时间多样性和收入缺口则小得多。这表明，一次性自我报告的残疾状况——这是大多数关于残疾对收入影响研究的基础——也低估了长期效应。
title: Losses from a Disability: Temporal Variety and Earnings in the Long Run

abstract: This study evaluates a nationwide malaria prevention campaign delivered through social media in India using a district-level cluster-randomized controlled trial. We combine two survey samples(N = 8,253) with administrative health records to assess effects on offline malaria-related behaviors and health outcomes. In the survey data, average treatment effects on protective behaviors, care-seeking intentions, and self-reported malaria incidence were small and insignificant. Administrative data similarly showed no detectable effect on overall recorded incidence. Post-hoc heterogeneity analysis, however, suggests that detectable effects were concentrated among households with higher socioeconomic status (SES) and in urban areas: for higher-SES households, bednet use increased during the campaign and self-reported malaria incidence declined afterward. In administrative records, monthly malaria incidence in urban areas fell by 6.2 cases per million people, a 33% decline relative to the pre-treatment rate. By contrast, estimates for lower-SES households and rural areas, which face higher malaria risk, were small and insignificant. In a second individual-level feed experiment (N = 1,542) that made ad delivery and exposure more comparable across SES groups, the ads increased bednet use and timely treatment-seeking intentions, with no detectable differences by SES. These patterns are consistent with delivery frictions contributing to the campaign
abstract_zh: 本研究通过一项以地区为集群的随机对照试验，评估了印度通过社交媒体开展的一项全国性疟疾预防运动。我们将两个调查样本（N = 8,253）与行政健康记录相结合，以评估其对线下疟疾相关行为和健康结果的影响。在调查数据中，对保护行为、就医意向及自我报告的疟疾发病率，平均处理效应较小且不显著。行政数据同样未显示对总体记录发病率有可检测的影响。然而，事后异质性分析表明，可检测的效应集中在社会经济地位（SES）较高及城市地区的家庭中：对于高SES家庭，蚊帐使用率在运动期间有所增加，而自我报告的疟疾发病率在之后有所下降。在行政记录中，城市地区的月度疟疾发病率每百万人下降了6.2例，相对于处理前水平下降了33%。相比之下，对于面临更高疟疾风险的低SES家庭和农村地区，估计效应较小且不显著。在第二个个体层面的信息流实验中（N = 1,542），该实验使不同SES群体间的广告投放和曝光更具可比性，广告增加了蚊帐使用和及时就医意向，且未发现按SES分组的可检测差异。这些模式与投放摩擦对运动效果的影响相一致。
