abstract: This paper estimates the causal effect of body mass index (BMI) on hypertension risk using data from the Young Finns Study. The empirical framework combines genetic instruments for BMI with a triangular copula model that accommodates a binary outcome and a continuous endogenous treatment, allowing unobserved determinants of BMI and hypertension to be correlated through alternative symmetric and asymmetric copula specifications. Sensitivity analyses examine alternative copula families and nested BMI genetic-score constructions to address pleiotropy concerns. The results show that higher BMI increases hypertension risk across ordered blood-pressure severity categories. Probability-scale treatment effects reveal a nonlinear pattern: marginal risk is concentrated in clinically relevant regions of the BMI distribution and shifts from early blood-pressure elevation toward more severe hypertension as body mass increases. The findings illustrate how genetic instruments and copula-based triangular models can be combined to study endogenous continuous treatments with nonlinear health outcomes, while identifying where along the BMI distribution marginal increases in body mass are most consequential for blood-pressure risk.
abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰青年研究数据，估计了体质指数（BMI）对高血压风险的因果效应。实证框架将BMI的遗传工具变量与三角copula模型相结合，该模型能适应二元结果和连续内生处理变量，允许BMI和高血压的未观测决定因素通过替代的对称和非对称copula设定相关联。敏感性分析考察了不同的copula族和嵌套的BMI遗传评分构建，以应对多效性担忧。结果显示，BMI升高增加了按血压严重程度有序分类的高血压风险。概率尺度上的处理效应揭示了非线性模式：边际风险集中在BMI分布的临床相关区域，并随着体质增加从早期血压升高转向更严重的高血压。研究结果展示了如何结合遗传工具变量和基于copula的三角模型来研究具有非线性健康结果的内生连续处理变量，同时识别出BMI分布中体质边际增加对血压风险影响最为显著的区间。
title: The Causal Effect of BMI on Hypertension: A Copula Model Approach with Genetic Risk Instruments
title_zh: BMI对高血压的因果效应：基于遗传风险工具与Copula模型的方法

abstract: Real GDP per person is a widely used proxy for living standards, but it can be a poor welfare measure when new goods or quality improvements matter, when nonmarket goods are significant, and when preferences are nonhomothetic --- all of which are true in practice. We propose an alternative that is robust to these concerns: under weak conditions, the growth rate of the value of a statistical life (VSL), together with standard Euler-equation objects, identifies the growth rate of lifetime utility. The intuition is that people routinely trade off consumption against mortality risk, and their willingness to pay for small risk reductions reveals the value of remaining lifetime utility. Implementing this approach for the United States suggests that lifetime utility may have risen by more than a factor of five since 1940, whereas conventional consumption-based calculations using a stable log/CRRA flow utility imply much smaller gains, on the order of a doubling. This calculation is sensitive to measures of the growth rate of the VSL, the rate of time preference, and the interest rate. For example, if the correct interest rate is 4 percentage points higher than the T-bill rate, then lifetime utility would be measured to have declined by more than half since 1940.
abstract_zh: 实际人均GDP是衡量生活水平的常用指标，但在新产品或质量改进重要、非市场商品显著以及偏好非齐次的情况下，它可能是一个不佳的福利度量——而这些情况在实践中均存在。我们提出了一种对这些担忧具有稳健性的替代方案：在较弱条件下，统计生命价值（VSL）的增长率，连同标准的欧拉方程对象，能够识别终身效用的增长率。其直觉在于，人们日常会在消费与死亡风险之间进行权衡，而他们为小幅风险降低所支付的意愿揭示了剩余终身效用的价值。将这一方法应用于美国，结果表明自1940年以来，终身效用可能增长了五倍以上，而基于稳定对数/CRRA流动效用的传统消费计算则显示增长幅度小得多，约为两倍。这一计算对VSL增长率、时间偏好率和利率的度量敏感。例如，如果正确的利率比国库券利率高出4个百分点，那么自1940年以来终身效用将被测为下降了一半以上。
title: When GDP Misleads: Inferring Living Standards from the Value of a Statistical Life
title_zh: 当GDP误导时：从统计生命价值推断生活水平

abstract: We ask how a younger sibling’s physical disability affects sibling mental health using Danish register data on families with three or more children. Difference-in-difference models compare first- and second-born children when the third-born does or does not have a disability. Use of mental health services increases 13% among second-born children, with a 23% increase in psychiatric visits and an 18% increase in use of psychiatric medications. Effects are concentrated in households where the mother has less than high school and persist after conditioning on child test scores. Parental responses suggest that caregiving demands, stress, and strained resources are potential mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦拥有三个及以上子女家庭的登记数据，探讨年幼弟妹的身体残疾如何影响兄弟姐妹的心理健康。双重差分模型比较了第三胎子女有或无残疾时，第一胎和第二胎子女的情况。第二胎子女的心理健康服务使用率增加了13%，其中精神科就诊次数增加23%，精神科药物使用增加18%。这些影响集中在母亲教育水平低于高中的家庭中，并且在控制儿童测试成绩后依然存在。父母的反应表明，照护需求、压力及资源紧张是潜在的作用机制。
title: Child Disability and Effects on Sibling Mental Health
title_zh: 儿童残疾及其对兄弟姐妹心理健康的影响

abstract: We study the effect of drug decriminalization on overdose mortality using Oregon
abstract_zh: 我们研究了药物非刑事化对过量死亡率的影响，以俄勒冈州为例。
title: Did Drug Decriminalization Increase Overdoses
title_zh: 毒品非刑事化是否增加了药物过量

abstract: We develop a quantitative macroeconomic theory of child mental health. The theory is grounded in child psychiatry, formalized in a life-cycle heterogeneous agent model of child development, and disciplined using micro data on mental health of children and parents. Intergenerational transmission of mental illness arises due to both biological factors and parental behavior. Parents experiencing mental illness have negative expectations and lose time due to rumination. As a result, they invest less in their child
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于儿童心理健康的定量宏观经济理论。该理论基于儿童精神病学，通过一个儿童发展的生命周期异质性主体模型加以形式化，并利用儿童及父母心理健康的微观数据进行校准。精神疾病的代际传递源于生物学因素和父母行为两方面。患有精神疾病的父母持有消极预期，并因反复思虑而损失时间。因此，他们对子女的投资减少。
title: The Macroeconomics of Intergenerational Mental Health Dynamics
title_zh: 代际心理健康动态的宏观经济学

abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method
abstract_zh: 环境决策往往影响健康，然而疾病负担的价值评估仍具挑战性，现有方法如疾病成本（COI）指标和质量调整生命年未能反映个体为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出一种新颖的框架，用于跨健康状况评估疾病负担，利用广泛可得的偏好权重和已知支付意愿（WTP）的基线状况，推导出WTP估计值。我们的分析显示，WTP估计显著高于常用的COI指标，表明政策评估中对健康状态的估值偏低。敏感性分析强调的变异与统计生命价值的变异一致，凸显了该方法的
title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
title_zh: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架

abstract: Using three independent archival sources, we previously documented substantial declines in stunting and wasting in Portugal during the mid-twentieth century. This note revisits the original evidence, clarifies the descriptive scope of our analysis, and situates the observed anthropometric changes within the broader evolution of public health, nutrition, and social policy in Portugal. We show that the timing and magnitude of the declines are robust to the alternative data restrictions and aggregation choices examined here, and that the documented improvements are consistent with contemporaneous expansions in health infrastructure and access documented in the historical record.
abstract_zh: 利用三个独立的档案来源，我们先前记录了二十世纪中叶葡萄牙发育迟缓与消瘦现象的显著下降。本注释重新审视原始证据，明确我们分析的描述性范围，并将观察到的体格测量变化置于葡萄牙公共卫生、营养及社会政策更广泛演变背景中。我们表明，这些下降的时间与幅度对于此处考察的替代数据限制和聚合选择具有稳健性，且记录到的改善与历史记载中同期卫生基础设施及可及性的扩展相一致。
title: Economic Progress in Twentieth-Century Portugal: Revisiting the Evidence
title_zh: 二十世纪葡萄牙的经济进步：重新审视证据

abstract: This paper examines the causal relationship between student debt and mental health using the 2015 Dutch student finance reform as a natural experiment. The reform replaced a universal grant with income-contingent loans for higher-education students, leaving vocational students unaffected and serving as a natural comparison group. Low-income students were partly compensated through expanded targeted support. Using nationwide administrative data from Statistics Netherlands, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing clinically diagnosed depression, anxiety, and broader mental health outcomes between higher education and vocational education students before and after the reform. We find no evidence of adverse mental health effects from the transition to debt-based financing. At the same time, students adjusted their behaviour by marginally increasing labour earnings and remaining longer in co-residence with their parents. These findings suggest that behavioural responses to the reform may have mitigated financial strain, although lenient repayment terms likely also cushioned the impact of the reform. Overall, the results indicate that the mental health impact of student debt may depend not only on financial exposure but also on institutional context and individuals' ability to adjust.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2015年荷兰学生资助改革作为自然实验，考察学生债务与心理健康之间的因果关系。该改革将高等教育学生的普遍性助学金替换为按收入比例偿还的贷款，而职业教育学生未受影响，作为自然对照组。低收入学生通过扩大定向支持得到部分补偿。利用荷兰统计局的全国行政数据，我们采用双重差分设计，比较改革前后高等教育与职业教育学生在临床诊断的抑郁症、焦虑症及更广泛心理健康结果上的差异。研究发现，转向债务型资助并未对心理健康产生不利影响的证据。同时，学生通过略微增加劳动收入并延长与父母同住的时间来调整自身行为。这些发现表明，对改革的应对行为可能缓解了经济压力，尽管宽松的还款条款也可能缓冲了改革的影响。总体而言，结果表明学生债务对心理健康的影响不仅取决于经济暴露程度，还取决于制度环境及个体的适应能力。
title: From Grants to Loans: Mental Health and Adaptive Responses to the 2015 Dutch Student Finance Reform
title_zh: 从补助到贷款：2015年荷兰学生资助改革中的心理健康与适应性应对

abstract: When governments face fiscal stress, they frequently manage consolidation by delaying cash payments on legally incurred obligations rather than cutting explicit appropriations. This "execution wedge" reduces the real resources available for public production while leaving formal appropriations unchanged. We identify the causal effect of this adjustment margin using monthly administrative data from Ecuadors public health system, exploiting institutional features that make the cash execution pipeline observable and its frictions plausibly exogenous. A one-standard-deviation increase in the execution wedge reduces hospital discharges by 19.9 percent and increases the conditional inpatient mortality rate after 48 hours by 59 percent. Conversely, mortality within 48 hours an indicator of patient severity at arrival, is unaffected. These findings demonstrate that payment timing operates as an active fiscal policy variable with first-order welfare costs that are unmeasured in standard fiscal policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 当政府面临财政压力时，它们常常通过延迟支付合法产生的债务现金，而非削减明确的拨款，来实施财政整顿。这种“执行缺口”减少了可用于公共生产的实际资源，同时正式拨款保持不变。我们利用厄瓜多尔公共卫生系统的月度行政数据，识别了这一调整边际的因果效应，利用制度特征使现金执行流程可观察，且其摩擦具有合理的外生性。执行缺口每增加一个标准差，医院出院人数减少19.9%，48小时后的条件住院死亡率增加59%。相反，48小时内的死亡率——作为入院时患者严重程度的指标——则不受影响。这些发现表明，支付时点作为一种活跃的财政政策变量，其福利成本的一阶效应在标准财政政策分析中未被计量。
title: The Unmeasured Cost of Fiscal Execution: Payment Timing and Public Service Delivery
title_zh: 财政执行中的隐性成本：支付时点与公共服务供给

abstract: We examine whether research systems reallocate scientific effort as health needs change. We assemble a global disease--location panel for 204 countries and territories (1990--2021) by linking disease-specific publication output to disease burden in the same place and year. Using large language models, we extract diseases from article text, map them into a standardized disease classification, and classify research funders by type. Empirically, we estimate how publication output co-moves with disease burden within countries and diseases over time, and we use event-study difference-in-differences designs that exploit plausibly exogenous variation from the timing of outbreak alerts. We find that responsiveness to endemic burden has increased over time but remains highly uneven across locations; outbreak alerts trigger rapid, statistically significant research surges that have strengthened in recent years; and funding composition is strongly associated with adjustment dynamics, with philanthropic and government-supported research contributing disproportionately to responsiveness growth in lower-income settings.
abstract_zh: 我们考察研究体系是否随着健康需求的变化而重新配置科研力量。通过将特定疾病的出版产出与同一地点和年份的疾病负担相关联，我们构建了一个覆盖204个国家和地区（1990-2021年）的全球疾病-地点面板数据。利用大型语言模型，我们从文章文本中提取疾病信息，将其映射到标准化的疾病分类中，并按类型对研究资助者进行分类。在实证分析中，我们估计了出版产出如何随国家内部和疾病随时间变化的疾病负担而共同变动，并采用事件研究双重差分设计，利用疫情警报时间点带来的看似外生的变异。我们发现，对地方性流行负担的响应性随时间增强，但在不同地点间仍高度不均；疫情警报会引发快速且统计上显著的研究激增，且近年来这种激增有所加强；资助构成与调整动态密切相关，其中慈善和政府支持的研究在低收入环境中的响应性增长中贡献尤为突出。
title: (How) Do Health Shocks Reallocate Research Direction?
title_zh: 健康冲击如何（以及是否）重新配置研究方向？

abstract: Much of the observed cross-country variation in fertility aligns with the predictions of classic theories of the fertility transition: countries with higher levels of human capital, higher GDP per capita, or lower mortality rates tend to exhibit lower fertility. However, when examining changes within countries over the past 60 years, larger fertility declines are only weakly associated with greater improvements in human capital, per capita GDP, or survival rates. To understand why, we focus on the role of family institutions, particularly marriage and inheritance customs. We argue that, together with the diffusion of cultural norms, they help explain variations in the timing, speed and magnitude of the fertility decline. We propose a stylized model integrating economic, health, institutional and cultural factors to study how these factors interact to shape fertility transition paths. We find that family institutions can mediate the effect of economic development by constraining fertility responses.
abstract_zh: 观察到的跨国生育率差异，在很大程度上与经典生育转型理论的预测相符：人力资本水平较高、人均GDP较高或死亡率较低的国家，往往表现出较低的生育率。然而，在审视过去60年各国国内变化时，较大的生育率下降与人力资本、人均GDP或生存率的更大改善之间仅存在微弱关联。为理解这一现象，我们聚焦于家庭制度的作用，特别是婚姻和继承习俗。我们认为，这些制度与文化规范的传播相结合，有助于解释生育率下降在时间、速度和幅度上的差异。我们提出一个整合经济、健康、制度和文化的简化模型，以研究这些因素如何相互作用塑造生育转型路径。我们发现，家庭制度可能通过约束生育反应来调节经济发展的影响。
title: Family Institutions and the Global Fertility Transition
title_zh: 家庭制度与全球生育率转型

abstract: This systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression evaluates twenty years of literature on data-driven identification of common PTSD symptom trajectories following potentially traumatic events. Traditional, machine learning- and large language model–assisted systematic search approaches were combined to identify eligible articles applying statistical Growth Mixture Modeling to longitudinally assessed PTSD symptom severity. Ninety-nine studies representing 113 independent samples and 215, 136 participants from 21 countries were included. We identified five prototypical PTSD symptom trajectories that commonly occurred across samples. We determined pooled relative trajectory prevalence estimates across samples observing these specific trajectories with the low symptoms trajectory being the most and the increasing symptoms trajectory the least prevalent. Using meta-regression, various socio-demographic, exposure-related and methodological moderators of sample-level relative trajectory prevalences were identified. Our findings provide empirical support and further refinements of leading theoretical PTSD conceptualizations. Furthermore, the obtained relative prevalence estimates and sample-level moderators may inform population-tailored trauma-related mental health care.
abstract_zh: 本系统综述、荟萃分析及荟萃回归评估了二十年来关于创伤后应激障碍症状轨迹数据驱动识别的研究文献。结合传统、机器学习及大型语言模型辅助的系统检索方法，识别出符合条件的研究，这些研究应用统计增长混合模型对纵向评估的PTSD症状严重程度进行分析。共纳入来自21个国家的99项研究，涵盖113个独立样本及215,136名参与者。我们识别出五种典型的PTSD症状轨迹，这些轨迹在样本中普遍出现。我们确定了观察这些特定轨迹的样本中，轨迹相对患病率的汇总估计，其中低症状轨迹最为普遍，而症状递增轨迹最为罕见。通过荟萃回归分析，我们识别出多种社会人口学、暴露相关及方法论层面的调节变量，这些变量影响样本层面的相对轨迹患病率。我们的研究结果为领先的PTSD理论概念化提供了实证支持，并进一步加以完善。此外，所获得的相对患病率估计及样本层面调节变量可为针对人群定制的创伤相关心理健康护理提供参考。
title: PTSD Symptom Trajectories in the Wake of Potentially Traumatic Events: a Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 20 Years of Research
title_zh: 潜在创伤事件后PTSD症状轨迹：20年研究的系统综述与荟萃分析

abstract: We provide long-run regional evidence on how local support for Brexit is associated with post-referendum life satisfaction. Covering 348 UK local authorities from 2011 to 2022, we find that after the 2016 referendum higher district-level Leave vote shares are associated with relative increases in life satisfaction. These results are robust across alternative treatment definitions, dynamic specifications, regional sensitivity checks and controls for the COVID-19 pandemic. Additional analyses suggest that the association emerges immediately after the referendum, is stronger in structurally vulnerable districts, and is weaker in areas with stronger petition-based demand for reversing Brexit. The findings may be associated with a regional political "winner effectâ€ and/or may reflect alignment between regional political preferences and the referendum outcome.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于英国脱欧地方支持度与公投后生活满意度之间关系的长期区域证据。覆盖2011年至2022年间英国348个地方政府区域，我们发现2016年公投后，地区级脱欧投票份额较高与生活满意度的相对提升相关联。这些结果在替代性处理定义、动态规格、区域敏感性检验及对COVID-19疫情的控制下均保持稳健。进一步分析表明，这一关联在公投后立即显现，在结构脆弱地区更为显著，而在有更强请愿要求逆转脱欧的地区则较弱。这些发现可能与区域政治“赢家效应”有关，和/或反映了区域政治偏好与公投结果的一致性。
authors: Wolfgang Maennig (Chair for Economic Policy, University of Hamburg)
Niklas Rohde (Chair for Economic Policy, University of Hamburg)
title: Satisfied or Bregret? Long-Term Implications of the Brexit Vote on Life Satisfaction
title_zh: 满意还是“悔脱”？英国脱欧公投对生活满意度的长期影响

abstract: In response to rising urban air pollution, European cities have adopted Low Emission Zones (LEZs), restricting the most polluting vehicles. While effective in improving air quality, these policies remain controversial due to concerns over fairness and acceptability. This paper examines the impact of London’s 2021 and 2023 Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ) expansions on Subjective Well-Being (SWB). Using panel data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and a staggered difference-in-differences design with individual and year fixed effects, we compare changes in life satisfaction among residents inside and outside the affected areas. We find that the 2021 expansion led to a decline in life satisfaction by approximately 0.4 points. We explore the mechanisms driving this decline and find that the well-being loss is mediated by car dependency and transport mode availability. While the policy increased reliance on public transport, we show that a better accessibility to public transport mitigates the decline in life satisfaction among London residents. Furthermore, we show that the well-being costs of the policy are regressive, disproportionately affecting lower-income households. These findings suggest that LEZs can generate short-term and unequal well-being costs despite achieving modest behavioural change, highlighting the need for complementary measures to enhance social acceptability.
abstract_zh: 针对城市空气污染日益加剧的问题，欧洲城市采取了低排放区（LEZs）措施，限制高污染车辆的使用。尽管这些政策在改善空气质量方面成效显著，但因其公平性与可接受性方面的担忧而备受争议。本文考察了伦敦2021年及2023年超低排放区（ULEZ）扩展对主观幸福感（SWB）的影响。利用英国家庭纵向研究的面板数据，并采用包含个体及年份固定效应的交错双重差分设计，我们比较了受影响区域内外居民生活满意度的变化。研究发现，2021年的扩展导致生活满意度下降约0.4个百分点。我们进一步探究了这一下降背后的机制，发现幸福感损失受汽车依赖度及交通方式可用性的中介作用影响。尽管政策增加了对公共交通的依赖，但研究表明，更好的公共交通可达性能够缓解伦敦居民生活满意度的下降。此外，我们还发现该政策的幸福感成本具有累退性，对低收入家庭的影响尤为显著。这些发现表明，低排放区在实现适度行为改变的同时，可能产生短期且不平等的幸福感成本，凸显了采取补充措施以增强社会可接受性的必要性。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为伦敦ULEZ扩张，数据来自英国纵向研究，政策背景为英国，与中国无直接关联。
title: The Well-Being Costs of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from London's ULEZ Expansions
title_zh: 低排放区的福利成本：来自伦敦ULEZ扩展的证据

abstract: Using large-scale high-granularity data from a food delivery platform and granular pollution and weather information, we study how PM 2.5 fluctuations affect riders' absenteeism, productivity, and accidents. Exploiting exogenous pollution variation from inverse boundary layer height, we find that higher pollution increases absenteeism for all workers and raises delivery times and accident rates only among (e-)bike riders, who must exert physical effort while working. Affected workers compensate productivity losses by working longer hours. Monetary incentives mitigate the effects on absenteeism but do not offset the decline in productivity and appear to exacerbate accident risk.
abstract_zh: 利用某外卖平台的大规模高粒度数据以及细颗粒物污染与天气信息，我们研究了PM2.5波动如何影响骑手的缺勤、生产率及事故发生率。借助逆边界层高度带来的外生污染变化，我们发现污染加剧会增加所有工人的缺勤率，并仅提高（电动）自行车骑手的配送时间和事故率，这些骑手在工作中需付出体力劳动。受影响的工人通过延长工作时间来弥补生产率损失。金钱激励缓解了缺勤效应，但并未抵消生产率下降，反而似乎加剧了事故风险。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要未提及中国、中国企业、中国人群或中国地区，研究对象为某食品配送平台工人，作者为意大利学者，无中国制度或政策背景，故判定为非中国研究。
title: Riders in the Smog: How Air Pollution Affects Workers in Urban Environments
title_zh: 雾霾中的骑行者：空气污染如何影响城市环境中的劳动者

abstract: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，考察了医院质量、患者选择及拥挤程度对均衡健康结果的影响。主要结局指标为死亡率，并通过距离工具变量控制未观测到的选择偏差。重症监护病房的负荷增加了医院死亡率：若无拥挤，死亡人数将下降9.6%。患者倾向于选择基线质量较高的医院，但其选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析显示，若患者获知容量压力信息并认为质量信号更为精确，死亡人数将减少3.8%。然而，若仅使用更精确的信息而未考虑拥挤因素，则会导致新冠死亡人数上升3.8%。
title: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
title_zh: 质量、选择与拥挤：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果

abstract: We use Bayesian meta-analysis methods to estimate the impact of unconditional cash transfers (UCTs). Aggregating evidence from 115 studies of 72 UCT programs in middle and low income countries, we find strong and positive average treatment effects on ten of thirteen outcomes: monthly household total and food consumption, monthly income, labor supply, school enrollment, food security, psychological well-being, total assets, financial assets, and children height-for-age. We examine seven specific theoretical and policy hypotheses, such as presence of savings frictions, dynamic effects, curvature of marginal returns, targeting effects, "nudgeâ€ effects, labor supply elasticity and related "dependencyâ€ theories, and contextual heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 我们采用贝叶斯元分析方法来评估无条件现金转移（UCTs）的影响。汇总来自中低收入国家72个UCT项目的115项研究证据，我们发现，在十三个结果指标中，有十个显示出强烈且正面的平均处理效应：月度家庭总消费和食品消费、月度收入、劳动力供给、学校入学率、食品安全、心理健康、总资产、金融资产以及儿童身高年龄比。我们检验了七个具体的理论和政策假设，包括储蓄摩擦的存在、动态效应、边际回报的曲率、目标定位效应、“助推”效应、劳动力供给弹性及相关“依赖”理论，以及情境异质性。
title: Unconditional Cash Transfers: A Bayesian Meta-Analysis of Randomized Evaluations in Low and Middle Income Countries
title_zh: 无条件现金转移：中低收入国家随机评估的贝叶斯元分析

abstract: The implementation and unwinding of the FFCRA's continuous coverage requirement generated historically large changes in Medicaid enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a combination of descriptive and causal analyses, we examine the substantial cross-state differences in these changes, which remain little understood. We find that policies designed to ease unwinding frictions, as well as federal fiscal assistance to states, have little predictive power, suggesting limited roles for administrative design or liquidity constraints. Political preferences have modest predictive power during the unwinding period. Pandemic-era Medicaid expansions and more generous baseline eligibility thresholds are strongly associated with larger net enrollment gains.
abstract_zh: FFCRA连续覆盖要求的实施与解除，在COVID-19疫情期间引发了医疗补助（Medicaid）参保人数的历史性大幅变动。通过结合描述性与因果分析，我们考察了各州在这些变动中存在的显著差异，而这一差异至今仍鲜有理解。我们发现，旨在缓解解除摩擦的政策以及联邦对各州的财政援助，其预测能力甚微，这表明行政设计或流动性约束的作用有限。政治偏好仅在解除期间具有适度的预测能力。疫情期间的医疗补助扩展及更为宽松的基线资格门槛，与更大的净参保增长密切相关。
title: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: 理解新冠疫情期间及之后医疗补助参保的跨州差异

abstract: Egypt's demographic trajectory has shifted markedly over recent decades, with fertility declines in the 1980s and 1990s followed by a reversal that peaked at 3.5 children per woman in 2014. While previous research has examined determinants such as women's employment, contraceptive use, and migration, the role of housing policy remains largely unexplored. This study investigates the impact of Egypt's 1996 rental market liberalization on fertility. Using four waves of the Egypt Labor Market Panel Survey (ELMPS) combined with district-level housing data from the 2006 Census, we exploit geographic and temporal variation in exposure to the reform. We examine whether women of marriageable age in 1996 living in districts with greater availability of liberalized rental units experienced different fertility outcomes. Results show that exposure to the reform increased the likelihood of childbearing and positively affected other fertility measures, including age at first birth and parity at ages 25, 30, and 35. Evidence suggests that earlier marriage is the main mechanism, consistent with the reform lowering housing constraints for young couples.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，埃及的人口结构轨迹发生了显著变化：20世纪80年代至90年代生育率下降后出现逆转，于2014年达到每名妇女生育3.5个子女的峰值。尽管已有研究探讨了女性就业、避孕措施使用及人口迁移等影响因素，但住房政策的作用仍鲜有涉及。本研究考察了埃及1996年租赁市场自由化对生育率的影响。通过运用四轮埃及劳动力市场面板调查数据，结合2006年人口普查中的地区级住房数据，我们利用改革暴露程度的地理与时间差异进行分析。研究检验了1996年处于婚育年龄的女性中，居住在自由化租赁住房供应更充足地区的群体是否呈现不同的生育结果。结果表明，改革暴露程度提高了生育可能性，并对其他生育指标产生正向影响，包括初育年龄及25岁、30岁、35岁时的生育数量。证据表明，早婚是主要作用机制，这与改革降低了年轻夫妇住房约束的结论一致。
title: Housing Policy and Fertility Behavior in Egypt: Evidence from the 1996 Rental Liberalization
title_zh: 埃及住房政策与生育行为：来自1996年租赁自由化的证据

abstract: Education is widely associated with better health outcomes, but whether this relationship is causal remains unclear, especially in low-income countries. This study examines the causal effect of maternal education on child nutrition and dietary diversity in Kenya. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, with exposure to the 2003 school reform as an instrument for educational attainment, the analysis finds that an additional year of maternal schooling significantly improves children's nutritional status and dietary diversity. Positive effects are observed for both boys and girls, although they are slightly stronger for boys. The results are robust to a range of sensitivity tests. Further analysis suggests that maternal education improves child health through several channels, including delayed first birth, fewer children under age five, higher paternal education, greater use of prenatal care, increased access to information through newspapers and television, improved literacy, and higher employment rates among mothers. These findings indicate that expanding educational opportunities for girls can be an effective policy tool for improving child nutrition and feeding practices in developing countries such as Kenya.
abstract_zh: 教育通常与更好的健康结果相关联，但这种关系是否具有因果性仍不明确，尤其是在低收入国家。本研究探讨了肯尼亚母亲教育对儿童营养和膳食多样性的因果效应。采用模糊断点回归设计，以2003年学校改革作为教育程度的工具变量，分析发现母亲每多接受一年教育，能显著改善儿童的营养状况和膳食多样性。对男孩和女孩均观察到积极影响，但对男孩的影响略强。结果在一系列敏感性检验中保持稳健。进一步分析表明，母亲教育通过多个渠道改善儿童健康，包括推迟首次生育、减少五岁以下子女数量、提高父亲教育水平、增加产前护理使用、通过报纸和电视获取更多信息、提升识字率以及提高母亲就业率。这些发现表明，扩大女孩教育机会可以成为改善肯尼亚等发展中国家儿童营养和喂养实践的有效政策工具。
title: Can Maternal Education Improve Children's Dietary Diversity and Nutritional Outcomes? Evidence from the 2003 Education Reform in Kenya
title_zh: 母亲教育能否改善儿童的膳食多样性和营养结果？来自肯尼亚2003年教育改革的证据

abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices Ã la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them – its saturation point – and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point.. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——一类是利基卖家，其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐；另一类是大众市场卖家，其商品受所有买家青睐。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异导致了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在略超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点（即饱和点）之上，并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于受限制的买家而言，两个平台的运营均超过了饱和点。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。
authors: Cai, Xiaoming (Peking University HSBC Business School)
title: Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
title_zh: 平台控制下的搜索与注意力分配扭曲

abstract: We study the effects of job loss and unemployment insurance (UI) on health among Brazilian workers. We construct a novel dataset linking individual-level administrative records on employment, hospital discharges, and mortality for a 17-year period, rarely available in the context of developing countries. Leveraging mass layoffs for identification, we find that job loss increases hospitalization (+33%) and mortality risks (+23%) for male workers, while women are not affected. These effects are pervasive over the distribution of age, tenure, income and education, and men
abstract_zh: 我们研究了失业及失业保险对巴西工人健康的影响。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，将17年期间个人层面的就业、住院记录和死亡率等行政记录关联起来，这在发展中国家背景下极为罕见。利用大规模裁员进行识别，我们发现失业使男性工人的住院风险增加33%，死亡风险增加23%，而女性未受影响。这些效应在年龄、工龄、收入和教育分布中普遍存在，且男性
title: Job Loss, Unemployment Insurance, and Health: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 失业、失业保险与健康：来自巴西的证据

abstract: Over 2 billion people worldwide travel long distances daily to fetch water that is often unsafe for human consumption. This paper studies how lack of water can limit economic development and how families adapt to permanent shifts in water provision in rural areas. It studies a policy providing 1 million rain-fed water cisterns in Brazil's poorest and most drought-prone areas. Using unique individual-level administrative data and a difference-in-differences design, we show that the program substantially improved family welfare. In ten years, household dependency on cash transfers decrease by as much as 19 percentage points while formal labor earnings increase by 15% driven by an increase in off-farm jobs. In turn, hospitalizations due to waterborne diseases declined by 16% among adults and 37% among children, and compliance with cash transfer conditionalities on child health and education improved. Additional evidence suggests that these gains were driven by a relaxation of time constraints: cisterns markedly reduced the time burden of water collection, enabling beneficiaries to allocate more time to productive activities. A cost-benefit analysis indicates a high marginal value of public funds relative to a broad range of public policies.
abstract_zh: 全球超过20亿人每天需要长途跋涉取水，而这些水往往不适合人类饮用。本文研究水资源匮乏如何制约经济发展，以及农村家庭如何适应供水条件的永久性变化。我们聚焦于一项在巴西最贫困且最易干旱地区推广100万个雨水收集蓄水池的政策。利用独特的个人层面行政数据与双重差分法，研究发现该政策显著提升了家庭福利。十年间，家庭对现金转移支付的依赖度下降高达19个百分点，正规劳动收入增长15%，主要源于非农就业岗位的增加。与此同时，成人因水传播疾病住院率下降16%，儿童下降37%，且家庭对现金转移支付中儿童健康与教育附加条件的遵守情况有所改善。进一步证据表明，这些收益源于时间约束的缓解：蓄水池大幅减少了取水时间负担，使受益者能将更多时间投入生产活动。成本收益分析显示，相较于广泛公共政策，该政策的公共资金边际价值较高。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象、数据、政策背景均为巴西，不涉及中国
title: Cisterns, Climate Adaptation, and Economic Development
title_zh: 蓄水池、气候适应与经济发展

abstract: This paper examines the sharp decline in fertility across Latin America using both period and cohort measures. Combining Vital Statistics, Census microdata, and UN population data, we decompose changes in fertility by age, education, and joint age-education groups. We show that the decline in period fertility between 2000 and 2022 is driven primarily by reductions in within-group birth rates rather than by changes in population composition, with the largest contributions coming from younger and less-educated women. Comparing the cohort born in the mid 1950s and the one born in the mid 1970s, we find that the decline in completed fertility reflects not only delayed childbearing but also substantial reductions in the average number of children per woman. This is driven primarily by lower fertility among mothers rather than by rising childlessness. Our findings provide new evidence on the nature of Latin America's transition to below-replacement fertility and highlight several open questions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文利用时期与队列两种度量指标，考察了拉丁美洲生育率的急剧下降。通过整合生命统计数据、人口普查微观数据及联合国人口数据，我们按年龄、教育程度以及年龄-教育联合分组对生育率变化进行了分解。研究表明，2000年至2022年间时期生育率的下降主要源于组内生育率的降低，而非人口结构变化，其中年轻且受教育程度较低的女性贡献最大。对比20世纪50年代中期与70年代中期出生的队列，我们发现终身生育率的下降不仅反映了生育推迟，更体现了每位女性平均生育数量的显著减少。这一变化主要由已育女性生育率降低驱动，而非无子女比例上升所致。本研究为拉丁美洲向低于更替水平生育率转型的特征提供了新证据，并揭示了未来研究中若干待解的关键问题。
title: Understanding Latin America's Fertility Decline: Age, Education, and Cohort Dynamics
title_zh: 理解拉丁美洲生育率下降：年龄、教育与队列动态

abstract: We estimate the impacts of large-scale unconditional cash transfers on child survival. One-time transfers of USD 1000 were provided to over 10,500 poor households across 653 randomized villages in Kenya. We collected census data on over 100,000 births, including on mortality and cause of death, and detailed data on household health behaviors. Unconditional cash transfers (accounting for spillovers) lead to 48% fewer infant deaths before age one and 45% fewer child deaths before age five. Detailed data on cause of death, transfer timing relative to birth, and the location of health facilities indicate that unconditional cash transfers and access to delivery care are complements in generating mortality reductions: the largest gains are estimated in neonatal and maternal causes of death largely preventable by appropriate obstetric care and among households living close to physician-staffed facilities and those who receive the transfer around the time of birth, and treatment leads to a large increase in hospital deliveries (by 45%). The infant and child mortality declines are concentrated among poorer households with below median assets or predicted consumption. The transfers also result in a substantial decline of 51% in female labor supply in the three months before and the three months after a birth, and improved child nutrition. Infant and child mortality largely revert to pre-program levels after cash transfers end. Despite not being the main aim of the original program, we show that unconditional cash transfers in this setting may be a cost-effective way to reduce infant and child deaths.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了大规模无条件现金转移对儿童生存的影响。在肯尼亚653个随机村庄中，向超过10500户贫困家庭一次性发放了1000美元现金。我们收集了超过10万例出生人口的普查数据（包括死亡率与死因），以及家庭健康行为的详细数据。无条件现金转移（考虑溢出效应后）使一岁以下婴儿死亡率降低48%，五岁以下儿童死亡率降低45%。关于死因、转移支付时间与出生时间的关系以及医疗设施位置的详细数据表明，无条件现金转移与分娩护理的可及性在降低死亡率方面具有互补效应：最大收益体现在可通过适当产科护理预防的新生儿和孕产妇死因上，且集中在居住于配备医生设施附近、在分娩前后获得转移支付的家庭中；干预措施使医院分娩量大幅增加45%。婴儿和儿童死亡率的下降主要集中于资产或预测消费低于中位数的贫困家庭。转移支付还导致女性在分娩前后各三个月的劳动供给大幅下降51%，并改善了儿童营养状况。现金转移结束后，婴儿和儿童死亡率基本恢复至项目前水平。尽管并非原始项目的主要目标，我们证明在此情境下，无条件现金转移可能是降低婴儿和儿童死亡率的成本有效方式。
title: Can Cash Transfers Save Lives? Evidence from a Large-Scale Experiment in Kenya
title_zh: 现金转移能否拯救生命？来自肯尼亚大规模实验的证据

abstract: This paper reassesses the relationship between foreign direct investment (FDI) and economic growth in emerging and developing economies. Using cross-country data, it first shows that the relationship between FDI, growth, and local conditions such as financial depth and human capital is not stable over time: complementarities documented in studies based on data from the 1970s and 1980s largely disappear in more recent decades. It then builds a new dataset on sectoral FDI covering 112 emerging and developing economies and documents substantial heterogeneity in the association between FDI and sectoral growth. FDI inflows are positively associated with growth in the primary sector, show no robust relationship in the secondary sector, and are negatively associated with growth in the tertiary sector. To interpret these patterns, we examine the role of global value chains (GVCs). We find that FDI is most strongly associated with growth in country-sectors with low GVC participation, while this relationship weakens or disappears as GVC integration increases. Moreover, the growth effects of FDI depend critically on the type of GVC integration. Backward participation amplifies the positive growth effects of FDI in the primary sector but attenuates them in the secondary sector and worsens the negative effects in tertiary sector, whereas forward participation strengthens the association between FDI and growth in manufacturing. Taken together, the results suggest that the elusive aggregate relationship between FDI and growth reflects a structural transformation in how foreign investment is embedded in global production networks: in highly fragmented value chains, FDI can expand gross activity without generating commensurate domestic value-added growth.
abstract_zh: 本文重新评估了外国直接投资（FDI）与新兴及发展中经济体经济增长之间的关系。基于跨国数据，本文首先发现FDI、经济增长与金融深化、人力资本等本地条件之间的关系随时间推移并不稳定：基于20世纪70年代和80年代数据的研究所揭示的互补性，在近几十年中基本消失。随后，本文构建了涵盖112个新兴及发展中经济体的部门层面FDI新数据集，并发现FDI与部门经济增长之间的关联存在显著异质性。FDI流入与第一产业增长呈正相关，与第二产业增长无稳健关联，与第三产业增长呈负相关。为解释这些模式，本文考察了全球价值链（GVC）的作用。研究发现，在GVC参与度较低的国别-部门中，FDI与经济增长的关联最为显著，而随着GVC一体化程度提高，这一关联减弱或消失。此外，FDI的增长效应关键取决于GVC一体化的类型。后向参与强化了FDI在第一产业的正向增长效应，但削弱了其在第二产业的效应并加剧了第三产业的负向效应；而前向参与则增强了FDI与制造业增长之间的关联。综合来看，研究结果表明，FDI与增长之间难以捉摸的总体关系，反映了外国投资嵌入全球生产网络方式的结构性转型：在高度碎片化的价值链中，FDI可能扩大总产出，却未能带来相应的国内增加值增长。
title: The Elusive Link Between FDI and Economic Growth: Sectoral Heterogeneity and Global Value Chains
title_zh: 外商直接投资与经济增长之间难以捉摸的联系：部门异质性与全球价值链

abstract: This paper examines how climate change and natural resource dynamics contribute to conflict, with a focus on the implications of the green transition. It reviews empirical evidence showing that extreme weather events - such as droughts, floods, and heatwaves - are linked to increased violence, particularly through economic disruptions, reduced agricultural productivity, and displacement. The analysis also explores the mechanisms through which climate shocks influence conflict, including opportunity costs, resource competition, and behavioral responses to environmental stress. The discussion then turns to the role of natural resource exploitation, especially in the context of rising demand for minerals essential to low-carbon technologies. The paper highlights how resource price and availability shocks can trigger conflict, often depending on the type of resource, extraction method, and local governance. It also addresses the overlap between climate- and resource-driven conflict risks, emphasizing that their interaction may amplify instability. Throughout, the paper identifies open research questions related to prediction, the effects of long-run environmental changes, and the design of policy responses. These include insurance schemes, climate adaptation strategies, infrastructure investment, and regulatory frameworks for resource governance. The findings point to the need for research that integrates climate and conflict dynamics, with the goal of informing policies that can mitigate the risks associated with environmental change and resource pressures.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨气候变化与自然资源动态如何加剧冲突，重点关注绿色转型的影响。通过梳理实证证据，研究发现极端天气事件（如干旱、洪水和热浪）与暴力事件增加存在关联，其传导机制主要体现为经济紊乱、农业减产及人口迁移。分析进一步揭示了气候冲击影响冲突的传导路径，包括机会成本变化、资源竞争加剧以及环境压力下的行为响应。随后，研究转向自然资源开采的作用，尤其聚焦低碳技术所需关键矿产需求上升的背景。本文强调，资源价格与供给冲击可能触发冲突，其影响程度取决于资源类型、开采方式及地方治理水平。研究还指出气候驱动与资源驱动的冲突风险存在重叠，二者相互作用可能加剧不稳定。全文系统梳理了预测方法、长期环境变化效应及政策响应设计等未解研究问题，涵盖保险机制、气候适应策略、基础设施投资及资源治理监管框架。研究结论表明，亟需开展气候与冲突动态的整合研究，为制定缓解环境变化与资源压力相关风险的政策提供依据。
title: Climate Change, Natural Resources, and Conflict

abstract: Little is known about the impact on small-scale enterprises of a large negative shock that destroys assets and disrupts local markets. We document the short- and long-run impacts of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami using longitudinal household survey data. We leverage topography-driven variation in exposure to the tsunami in coastal Aceh and North Sumatra, Indonesia. There are large short-run declines in business ownership, real profits, and real business assets among those exposed to the tsunami relative to comparison individuals who were not directly exposed. The gap in ownership rates disappears within two years in the non-agricultural sector but persists for 15 years in the agricultural sector. Profits and business assets of the exposed remain substantially lower through the long-term. Tsunami exposure led to increased short-duration transitions into and out of business ownership. Housing aid is linked to higher rates of non-agricultural business ownership and profits.
abstract_zh: 关于大规模负面冲击对小型企业的影响——这种冲击会摧毁资产并扰乱当地市场——目前所知甚少。我们利用纵向家庭调查数据，记录了2004年印度洋海啸的短期与长期影响。我们借助地形驱动的暴露差异，分析了印度尼西亚亚齐省和北苏门答腊省沿海地区受海啸影响的程度。与未直接暴露的对照组个体相比，受海啸影响的个体在商业所有权、实际利润和实际商业资产方面出现了显著的短期下降。非农业部门的商业所有权差距在两年内消失，但农业部门的差距持续了15年。受冲击者的利润和商业资产在长期内仍显著较低。海啸暴露导致商业所有权的短期进出频率增加。住房援助与非农业商业所有权及利润率的提高相关。
title: Reconstruction following Destruction: Entrepreneurship in the Aftermath of a Natural Disaster

abstract: Standard cohort-component projection models for India omit one of the most durable behavioural drivers of fertility: son preference operating through Differential Stopping Behaviour (DSB). This paper addresses that gap by introducing son preference as an explicit stratification dimension alongside education and urban-rural residence extending the Vienna School’s multi-dimensional demographic framework to include gender norms as a structural modifier of fertility. Using a relational Gompertz framework estimated from a 300-cell state-by-residence-by-son-preference-category-by-NFHS-round panel, we find that son preference raises TFR by 15.4 per cent net of all socioeconomic controls and shifts the fertility schedule toward older ages. A 10 per cent permanent reduction in DSB-driven fertility from 2021 yields approximately 50–60 million fewer people across 15 major states by 2100; an SSP2-style counterfactual places the full demographic cost at 426 million. Shift-share decomposition reveals that in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, cultural momentum defined as cumulative population divergence from the sustained gap between observed and structurally expected fertility operates alongside demographic momentum as a binding constraint. These results suggest that projection models conditioned only on development covariates may understate long-run population size in high-preference states.
abstract_zh: 印度标准队列要素预测模型忽略了生育率最持久的行为驱动因素之一：通过差异化停止行为（DSB）运作的男孩偏好。本文通过将男孩偏好作为与教育和城乡居住并列的明确分层维度，扩展了维也纳学派的多维人口学框架，将性别规范作为生育率的结构性调节因素，从而填补了这一空白。利用基于300个单元（按邦、居住地、男孩偏好类别和NFHS轮次划分的面板数据）估计的关系型Gompertz模型，我们发现，在控制所有社会经济变量后，男孩偏好使总和生育率（TFR）净提高15.4%，并将生育时间表向较高年龄推移。从2021年起，DSB驱动的生育率永久性降低10%，将使15个主要邦到2100年的人口减少约5000万至6000万；而SSP2式的反事实情景则显示，全部人口成本高达4.26亿。份额转移分解表明，在北方邦和北方邦，文化动量（定义为观察到的生育率与结构性预期生育率之间持续差距所累积的人口分化）与人口动量共同构成刚性约束。这些结果表明，仅以发展协变量为条件的预测模型可能低估高偏好邦的长期人口规模。

abstract: This paper analyzes trends in agricultural total factor productivity in Bolivia between 2008 and 2015 and the factors driving these trends using national agricultural surveys. On balance, the findings suggest that agricultural total factor productivity increased by 1.8% annually between 2008-2015. Among productive inputs, land shows the largest marginal effect on the value of agricultural production. Regarding temperature shocks, the study finds that each additional harmful degree day during the growing season is associated, on average, with a 9.8% decrease in the value of agricultural output. With regards to policy drivers, no statistically significant effect of land titling within the last two years is detected on productivity. Public irrigation infrastructure has a positive effect on productivity, though its magnitude decreases with rising incidence of precipitation. These findings underscore the importance of continuing to invest public resources efficiently in infrastructure that can boost agricultural productivity and prioritize investments targeting regions with the lowest productivity growth rates and with the smallest share of land and workers.
abstract_zh: 本文利用全国农业调查数据，分析了2008年至2015年间玻利维亚农业全要素生产率的趋势及其驱动因素。总体而言，研究结果表明，2008-2015年间农业全要素生产率年均增长1.8%。在生产投入要素中，土地对农业产值的边际效应最大。关于温度冲击，研究发现，生长季节每增加一个有害度日，农业产值平均下降9.8%。在政策驱动因素方面，未发现过去两年内土地确权对生产率具有统计上显著的影响。公共灌溉基础设施对生产率具有正向效应，但其影响程度随降水频率上升而递减。这些发现凸显了持续将公共资源高效投资于能够提升农业生产率的基础设施的重要性，并应优先针对生产率增长率最低、土地与劳动力占比最小的地区进行投资。
title: An Analysis of Agricultural Total Factor Productivity Growth and Its Determinants in Bolivia
title_zh: 玻利维亚农业全要素生产率增长及其决定因素分析

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of free primary education (FPE) on parents' fertility decisions in sub-Saharan Africa and how these effects depend on prevailing gender norms. Leveraging the staggered rollout of FPE across 17 countries and a within-ethnicity design, we find that the reform reduced completed fertility by 0.25 births per woman. Reduced fertility coincides with both improved child survival and school enrollment. Linking these data with ethnic-level cultural norms of male dominance, we show that these effects arise exclusively among groups with low male dominance. Consistent with fertility reductions increasing women's autonomy, FPE also strengthens women's outside options and intra-household bargaining power. In low male-dominance settings, this is reflected in higher divorce probabilities, lower acceptance of intimate partner violence, greater participation in household decisions, and increased media engagement - changes absent in high male-dominance cultures. A simple model embedding the quantity - quality tradeoff within a limited-commitment household bargaining framework, where gender norms determine women's veto power over fertility, rationalizes these findings. Overall, the results underscore the central role of gender norms in shaping the effects of policy interventions on fertility and broader development outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了撒哈拉以南非洲地区免费初等教育（FPE）对父母生育决策的影响，以及这些效应如何受主流性别规范的调节。利用17个国家分阶段推行FPE的政策差异及族群内部设计，我们发现该改革使每位女性的完成生育数减少0.25个。生育率下降与儿童存活率提升及入学率提高同步发生。通过将数据与反映男性主导地位的族群文化规范相关联，我们发现这些效应仅出现在男性主导程度较低的群体中。与生育率下降增强女性自主权相一致，FPE还提升了女性的外部选择权和家庭内部议价能力。在低男性主导环境中，这体现为离婚概率上升、对亲密伴侣暴力的接受度降低、家庭决策参与度提高以及媒体接触增加——而在高男性主导文化中则未观察到这些变化。一个嵌入数量-质量权衡且受有限承诺家庭议价框架约束的简单模型（其中性别规范决定女性对生育的否决权）可合理解释上述发现。总体而言，研究结果凸显了性别规范在塑造政策干预对生育及更广泛发展成果影响中的核心作用。
title: Gender Norms and the Quantity-Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa
title_zh: 性别规范与数量-质量权衡：来自非洲免费初等教育的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Data Exchange Platform (DEP) establishment on the green innovation of heavily polluting enterprises, with a focus on spatial spillover effects. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2014 to 2023, we employ a hybrid framework that combines machine learning techniques, causal econometric models with instrumental variables, and spatial econometric and regression methods. The results indicate that DEP significantly promotes green innovation in host cities. The main empirically verified mechanism lies in restraining greenwashing through enhanced data transparency. However, at the spatial level, DEP shows a significant negative spatial spillover effect under the baseline spatial weight matrix, indicating a possible resource siphon effect that concentrates data and innovation resources in platform-hosting locations. Marked regional heterogeneity is observed: local effects dominate in the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei and Pearl River Delta regions, while the Yangtze River Delta exhibits positive spillovers due to stronger regional integration. Firm-level analyses further reveal that DEP effects are strongest for firms in highly concentrated markets, small and medium-sized enterprises, and mature firms. Overall, the findings highlight data as a core production factor in green innovation and emphasize the need for spatially coordinated data governance to mitigate siphon effects and promote regional collaborative innovation. abstract_zh: 本文研究了数据交易平台（DEP）的建立对重污染企业绿色创新的影响，重点关注空间溢出效应。基于2014至2023年中国上市公司面板数据，我们采用融合机器学习技术、工具变量因果计量模型以及空间计量与回归方法的混合框架。结果表明，DEP显著促进了所在城市的绿色创新。实证验证的主要机制在于通过增强数据透明度抑制漂绿行为。然而，在空间层面，基准空间权重矩阵下DEP呈现显著的负向空间溢出效应，表明可能存在资源虹吸效应，即数据和创新资源向平台所在地集中。区域异质性显著：京津冀和珠三角地区以本地效应为主，而长三角地区因更强的区域一体化表现出正向溢出效应。企业层面分析进一步揭示，DEP效应在高度集中市场中的企业、中小企业以及成熟企业中最为显著。总体而言，研究结果凸显了数据作为绿色创新核心生产要素的作用，并强调需实施空间协调的数据治理以缓解虹吸效应，促进区域协同创新。关键词：数据交易平台 绿色创新 空间溢出效应 XGBoost-SHAP模型 地理高斯过程回归（GGPR） JEL分类：Q55 R11

abstract: Community forests (CFs) are a forest ownership and governance approach that enable community members and other key stakeholders to cooperatively manage local forests to produce a range of benefits that align with local community priorities. While well-studied internationally, there is a lack of research that systematically documents how CFs can contribute to rural prosperity in the U.S. amidst ongoing socioeconomic and environmental change. We adapt a framework developed to characterize the contributions of forests to rural prosperity in the international context to investigate the environmental, economic, and social benefits from CFs. In examining 18 in-depth CF case studies, we find that establishing CFs increases access to and control over local forests by local communities, allowing them to manage forests according to local priorities and needs. Economically, many CFs bring in earned income and employment, directly and indirectly, from forest products and services, and support local businesses through tourism and recreation. Social benefits of CFs include access to recreation opportunities, enhancing social relations, and building community identity, security, and empowerment. In extending existing rural prosperity frameworks, we propose that environmental benefits of CFs, including forest protection and restoration and reducing wildfire risk, also play a key role in enhancing rural prosperity. Evidence from these cases suggests that local governance of forests for the production of local benefits using a CF model is a promising approach to enhancing rural prosperity in the U.S.
abstract_zh: 社区森林（CFs）是一种森林所有权与治理方式，使社区成员及其他关键利益相关者能够合作管理当地森林，以产生符合当地社区优先事项的一系列效益。尽管在国际上已有充分研究，但关于社区森林如何在持续的社会经济和环境变化中促进美国农村繁荣的系统性文献仍显不足。我们借鉴了一个为描述国际背景下森林对农村繁荣贡献而开发的框架，用以探究社区森林带来的环境、经济和社会效益。通过考察18个深入的社区森林案例研究，我们发现建立社区森林增强了当地社区对本地森林的获取和控制能力，使其能够根据地方优先事项和需求管理森林。在经济方面，许多社区森林通过森林产品和服务直接或间接带来劳动收入与就业机会，并通过旅游和休闲活动支持当地企业。社会效益包括提供休闲机会、增进社会关系、构建社区认同感、安全感及赋权感。在扩展现有农村繁荣框架的基础上，我们提出社区森林的环境效益，包括森林保护与恢复以及降低野火风险，也在增强农村繁荣方面发挥关键作用。这些案例的证据表明，采用社区森林模式进行地方森林治理以生产地方效益，是提升美国农村繁荣的一条有前景的路径。
title: The contributions of community forests to rural prosperity in the United States
title_zh: 美国社区森林对农村繁荣的贡献

abstract: This paper investigates how the “ratchet effect” from the institutional linkage of current expenditures to future budget allocations drives excessive year-end government spending. Applying novel bunching estimation to 1.18 million Chinese procurement contracts (2015–2021), we quantify year-end excess spending, finding approximately 17.81 billion CNY in wasteful year-end spending annually. We show this rush manifests through two detrimental behaviors: regulatory evasion, which increases contract violations, and official discretion, which reduces the quality of suppliers. Exploiting China's Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB) reform in a difference-in-differences framework, we find that decoupling budgets across years reduces year-end overspending by 15.8%. Critically, the reform works primarily by curbing official discretion, while having limited impact on regulatory evasion. Our findings disentangle the behavioral mechanisms of year-end spending and provide key insights for designing effective budget reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当前支出与未来预算分配的制度性关联所产生的“棘轮效应”如何驱动年末政府过度支出。通过将新颖的聚束估计方法应用于2015至2021年间118万份中国采购合同，我们量化了年末超额支出，发现每年约有178.1亿元人民币的浪费性年末支出。我们表明，这种突击花钱表现为两种有害行为：规避监管，导致合同违规增加；以及官员自由裁量权，降低了供应商质量。利用中国零基预算改革，在双重差分框架下，我们发现跨年度预算脱钩使年末超支减少了15.8%。关键在于，该改革主要通过抑制官员自由裁量权发挥作用，而对规避监管的影响有限。我们的研究厘清了年末支出的行为机制，为设计有效的预算改革提供了关键见解。

abstract: Expectations are typically modeled as functions of an agent’s information set. Using preregistered evidence, we show that beliefs depend instead on the information agents retrieve when forming them. Even after observing identical histories of inflation or stock returns, individuals recall different observations, and their beliefs track what they retrieve. Selective recall therefore generates disagreement, within-person belief instability, and heterogeneity in subjective uncertainty without any new information. We formalize these patterns in a parsimonious model in which agents store observed signals, retrieve each only probabilistically, and update optimally using recalled rather than objectively available information. The model yields sharp predictions for how beliefs vary with the composition of stored information, recall probabilities, and contextual cues. Large-scale experiments that hold information fixed and intervene only after exposure confirm these predictions, while survey evidence on macroeconomic and financial expectations supports their external relevance. Disagreement, instability, and uncertainty are thus structural features of belief formation rather than mere measurement error.
abstract_zh: 预期通常被建模为个体信息集的函数。基于预注册实验证据，我们发现信念实际上取决于个体在形成预期时所提取的信息。即便观察完全相同的通胀或股票回报历史序列，不同个体回忆起的观测值也存在差异，而他们的信念恰恰与所回忆的内容保持一致。因此，选择性记忆会在无任何新信息输入的情况下，引发个体间信念分歧、个体内信念波动以及主观不确定性的异质性。我们通过一个简约模型将这些规律形式化：在该模型中，个体存储观测信号，仅以概率方式提取每个信号，并基于回忆信息（而非客观可用信息）进行最优更新。该模型对信念如何随存储信息构成、回忆概率及情境线索变化提供了精准预测。在固定信息集且仅在信息暴露后实施干预的大规模实验中，这些预测得到验证；而关于宏观经济与金融预期的调查证据则支持其外部有效性。由此表明，分歧、波动与不确定性是信念形成的结构性特征，而非单纯的测量误差。
title: Belief Disagreement, Instability, and Uncertainty under Stochastic Recall
title_zh: 随机回忆下的信念分歧、不稳定与不确定性

abstract: This paper studies whether behavioral interventions designed to promote resource conservation in one domain generate spillovers in another. Using a natural field experiment involving over 2,000 residents, we identify the direct and spillover effects of real-time feedback and social comparisons on water and energy consumption. We implement three interventions: two targeting shower use and one targeting air-conditioning use. We find significant reductions in shower use from both water-saving interventions, but no direct effect of the energy-saving intervention on air-conditioning use. For spillovers, we estimate precise null effects of water-saving interventions on air-conditioning use, and of the energy-saving intervention on shower use.
abstract_zh: 本文研究旨在促进某一领域资源节约的行为干预措施是否会在另一领域产生溢出效应。通过一项涉及2000多名居民的自然实地实验，我们识别了实时反馈与社会比较对水和能源消耗的直接效应及溢出效应。我们实施了三种干预措施：两种针对淋浴用水，一种针对空调用电。研究发现，两种节水干预措施均显著减少了淋浴用水，但节能干预措施对空调用电无直接效应。在溢出效应方面，我们估计出节水干预措施对空调用电以及节能干预措施对淋浴用水的精确零效应。

abstract: This paper examines the impact of roads on structural transformation and business composition both empirically and theoretically. Empirically, we find that major highway programs in India and China led to declines in the number of businesses where structural transformation is weak, and increases where it is strong. We develop a two-sector model of regional trade with endogenous firm entry that highlights two opposing forces. Ceteris paribus , lower trade costs in non-agriculture lead to fewer firms, but cheaper agricultural imports release labor from local agricultural production, leading to more firms. We show that the model-simulated outcomes reasonably replicate the empirical results, and that more rapid agricultural productivity growth in China differentiates the two countries.
abstract_zh: 本文从实证与理论两个层面探讨了道路建设对结构转型及企业构成的影响。实证研究发现，印度与中国的重大高速公路项目导致结构转型薄弱地区的企业数量减少，而结构转型强劲地区的企业数量增加。我们构建了一个包含内生企业进入的两部门区域贸易模型，揭示了两种相反的作用力：在其他条件不变的情况下，非农业贸易成本的降低会导致企业数量减少，但更廉价的农产品进口会释放本地农业劳动力，从而促使企业数量增加。研究表明，模型模拟结果能够合理复现实证结论，且中国更快的农业生产力增长是两国差异的关键因素。

abstract: Policies aimed at promoting currency internationalization often target frictions in both capital and current account transactions. We study this two-pronged approach using a dynamic general equilibrium model in which an international currency serves as both a store of value and a medium of exchange. Due to the complementarity between different functions of an international currency, a two-pronged approach is more effective than policies with a single focus. We analytically characterize this policy complementarity and apply the model to China’s renminbi internationalization reforms during 2010-2021. We find that: (1) These reforms reduced the return wedge on foreign held renminbi bonds by 4.1 percentage points (p.p.) and lowered the cost of renminbi-settled international trade by 0.9 p.p. in trade-revenue equivalent. (2) Policy complementarity accounted for half of the overall policy effect. (3) A single-focused policy — targeting only capital (current) account frictions — would have raised fiscal costs by a factor of 2.1 (1.8).
abstract_zh: 旨在促进货币国际化的政策往往针对资本与经常账户交易中的摩擦。我们通过一个动态一般均衡模型来研究这种双管齐下的策略，在该模型中，国际货币既充当价值储存手段，又充当交换媒介。鉴于国际货币不同功能之间的互补性，双管齐下的方法比单一聚焦的政策更为有效。我们从理论上刻画了这种政策互补性，并将模型应用于2010-2021年间中国人民币国际化的改革实践。研究发现：（1）这些改革使境外持有的人民币债券的回报率差距缩小了4.1个百分点，并以贸易收入等价计算，将人民币结算的国际贸易成本降低了0.9个百分点。（2）政策互补性贡献了总体政策效果的一半。（3）若仅针对资本（或经常）账户摩擦采取单一聚焦政策，财政成本将分别增加至原来的2.1倍（或1.8倍）。

abstract: Fossil fuels have shaped the European economy since the industrial revolution. We use new long-run panel data to analyse the effect of both, coal and oil on economic growth between 1900 and 2015, exploiting variation at the level of European NUTS2 and NUTS3 regions. We show that the reversal of fortune of coal regions resulted from the second energy transition. Specifically, an “oil invasion” in the early 1960s turned regional coal abundance from a blessing into a curse. Human capital accumulation contributed to this reversal of fortune and fully explains the negative effects until today. Moreover, we find substantial heterogeneity between former coal regions that is in line with Glaeser’s “reinvention hypothesis”: regions with a higher skill-level adjusted much better to the decline of coal. In particular, we show that coal regions with a higher urban density before 1800 were much more resilient than others.
abstract_zh: 自工业革命以来，化石燃料深刻塑造了欧洲经济。我们利用新的长期面板数据，以欧洲NUTS2和NUTS3区域为分析单元，考察了1900年至2015年间煤炭与石油对经济增长的影响。研究表明，煤炭产区的命运逆转源于第二次能源转型。具体而言，20世纪60年代初期的"石油入侵"使区域煤炭禀赋从福音转变为诅咒。人力资本积累促成了这一命运逆转，并完全解释了直至今日的负面效应。此外，我们发现前煤炭产区之间存在显著异质性，这与格莱泽的"再造假说"一致：技能水平较高的区域对煤炭产业衰退的适应能力显著更强。特别值得注意的是，1800年前城市密度较高的煤炭产区展现出远超其他地区的经济韧性。
title: Fickle fossils: Economic growth, coal, and the European oil invasion, 1900–2015
title_zh: 易变化石：经济增长、煤炭与欧洲石油入侵，1900–2015

abstract: We study whether the DeepSeek-R1 shock changed the market value of scarce AI compute. Using U.S. stock returns around January 27, 2025 and compute-supply exposure from pre-event 10-K filings, firms more exposed to supplying AI compute earned significantly lower abnormal returns. In the preferred specification, higher compute-supply exposure predicts a 2.37 percentage-point lower three-day cumulative abnormal return (CAR[-1,+1]). Results survive industry fixed effects, risk and financial controls, alternative benchmarks, placebo dates, and text-validation checks. The evidence suggests DeepSeek was priced as a shock to AI compute scarcity rents, not only a broad technology-sector shock.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了DeepSeek-R1冲击是否改变了稀缺AI算力的市场价值。利用2025年1月27日前后的美国股票回报率以及事件前10-K文件中披露的算力供应敞口，我们发现，更倾向于供应AI算力的公司在异常回报率上显著更低。在首选规格中，更高的算力供应敞口预示着三天累计异常回报率（CAR[-1,+1]）下降2.37个百分点。该结果在行业固定效应、风险与财务控制、替代基准、安慰剂日期以及文本验证检查中均保持稳健。证据表明，DeepSeek被定价为对AI算力稀缺性租金的冲击，而不仅仅是广泛的技术板块冲击。

abstract: Measuring systemic risk has been an important topic in recent research on risk management. Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016) pioneered the CoVaR measure for systemic risk, which is defined as the conditional quantile of system loss given some state predictors and one stress event of an individual loss at a certain risk level. They proposed to estimate CoVaR by a two-quantile-regression approach, which is simple and easy to implement in practice, but without stating or developing the necessary asymptotic theory. In this paper, we develop tests to reveal that using the classical regularity condition in quantile regressions for the two-quantile-regression model may be unrealistic by revisiting the datasets in Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016). Under the proposed weaker conditions, we further develop the asymptotic theory of the CoVaR inference and introduce a random weighted bootstrap method to quantify the inference uncertainty. We examine the finite sample performance of the proposed tests in terms of size and power, as well as the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals for CoVaR. Finally, we demonstrate the CoVaR inference across financial institutions and time.
abstract_zh: 衡量系统性风险一直是风险管理近期研究中的重要课题。Adrian和Brunnermeier（2016）开创性地提出了用于系统性风险的CoVaR度量，该度量定义为在给定某些状态预测因子和单个损失在特定风险水平下的压力事件条件下，系统损失的條件分位数。他们提出通过双分位数回归方法估计CoVaR，该方法在实践中简单易行，但未阐述或发展必要的渐近理论。本文通过重新审视Adrian和Brunnermeier（2016）的数据集，开发了检验方法，以揭示在双分位数回归模型中使用经典分位数回归正则条件可能不切实际。在提出的较弱条件下，我们进一步发展了CoVaR推断的渐近理论，并引入随机加权自助法来量化推断不确定性。我们检验了所提检验在规模和功效方面的有限样本性能，以及CoVaR置信区间的覆盖概率。最后，我们展示了跨金融机构和时间的CoVaR推断。
title: Asymptotics of CoVaR inference in two-quantile-regression
title_zh: 两分位数回归中CoVaR推断的渐近性质

abstract: We investigate the extent to which asylum policies that aim to deter individuals from migrating irregularly in fact do so. We specifically consider effects of Germany’s 2023 asylum policy adjustments, which include accelerated asylum decision processes, the prospect of asylum processing outside of Europe, the introduction of a payment card to replace cash benefits, and an extended waiting period for native-level benefits. To estimate the effects of these policy measures on irregular migration intent, we implement a conjoint experiment with 989 men aged 18–40 in four cities in Senegal, a country where irregular migration to Europe is highly salient. Offshoring the asylum process substantially lowers irregular migration intentions, and extending the waiting time for native-level benefits only has a small effect on intent. Neither reducing asylum processing times nor replacing cash benefits with a payment card alters intentions. Our study does not resolve political and normative questions concerning these policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在阻止个人非正规移民的庇护政策在多大程度上实际发挥了作用。我们特别关注德国2023年庇护政策调整的影响，包括加速庇护决策流程、将庇护处理程序转移至欧洲以外地区、引入支付卡替代现金福利，以及延长获得与本国居民同等福利的等待期。为评估这些政策对非正规移民意愿的影响，我们在塞内加尔四个城市对989名18至40岁男性实施了一项联合实验——该国非正规移民至欧洲的现象尤为突出。研究发现，将庇护程序外包至欧洲以外地区显著降低了非正规移民意愿，而延长获得与本国居民同等福利的等待期仅对意愿产生微弱影响。缩短庇护处理时间或用支付卡替代现金福利均未改变移民意愿。本研究未就这些政策涉及的政治与规范性问题作出定论。
title: Is irregular migration responsive to recent German asylum policy adjustments?
title_zh: 德国近期庇护政策调整是否对非正规移民产生了影响？

abstract: Tournaments are well studied objects in economic theory. Copeland (1951 A reasonable social welfare function. Tech. rep., Mimeo, University of Michigan USA")) provides an intuitive way to select alternatives from a tournament, the Copeland set . As a tournament solution, the Copeland set possesses many desirable properties and has been widely studied. Rubinstein (1980 Ranking the participants in a tournament. SIAM J Appl Math 38:108–111")) axiomatizes a method to rank alternatives from a tournament which is based on their Copeland scores . This paper analyzes the Copeland set from a revealed preference perspective. A choice procedure where a decision maker has a fixed underlying tournament and selects the Copeland set from every menu is behaviorally characterized.
abstract_zh: 锦标赛是经济理论中研究较为深入的对象。Copeland（1951，《一种合理的社会福利函数》，技术报告，密歇根大学，美国）提出了一种从锦标赛中筛选备选方案的直观方法，即Copeland集。作为一种锦标赛解概念，Copeland集具备诸多理想性质，并得到了广泛研究。Rubinstein（1980，《锦标赛参与者排序方法》，《SIAM应用数学杂志》第38卷，第108–111页）基于Copeland得分公理化了锦标赛备选方案的排序方法。本文从显示偏好视角分析Copeland集。研究对一种选择程序进行了行为特征刻画：在该程序中，决策者拥有固定的潜在锦标赛结构，并从每个备选菜单中选取Copeland集。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Copeland choice rules
title_zh: 科普兰选择规则

abstract: We examine how the impact of exports of goods and services on income per capita varies depending on the extent of labour rights violations in the export sector. In a sample of low- and middle-income countries, we find that specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations tends to reduce per capita income, due to lower productivity in those sectors. The negative impact of specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations is stronger in middle-income countries than in low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了商品与服务出口对人均收入的影响如何因出口部门劳动权益侵犯程度的不同而有所差异。基于中低收入国家样本，我们发现，专门从事劳动权益侵犯程度较高的部门往往会降低人均收入，其原因在于这些部门的生产率较低。相较于低收入国家，中等收入国家中专门从事高劳动权益侵犯部门所带来的负面效应更为显著。

abstract: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations - aka the CIP basis - in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM's lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk. To do so, we construct a â€˜purified' CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this â€˜purified' CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary's balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM's.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴市场（EM）中抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离——即CIP基差——的行为。计算新兴市场CIP基差的主要挑战在于衡量无本地信用风险的本地货币利率。为此，我们利用过去二十年新兴市场本地货币和美元计价的主权超国家债券，为八种主要新兴市场货币构建了“净化版”CIP基差。研究表明，这一“净化版”CIP基差与理论隐含预测高度吻合。在横截面和时间序列维度上，该基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关。全球美元融资成本冲击、全球中介机构资产负债表容量冲击以及美元安全资产需求冲击，会与货币特定的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，共同影响新兴市场的CIP基差变动。
title: Covered Interest Parity in Emerging Markets: Measurement and Drivers
title_zh: 新兴市场中的抛补利率平价：测度与驱动因素

abstract: Emerging markets have shown remarkable resilience during risk-off episodes in recent years. While favorable external conditions - good luck - contributed to this resilience, improvements in policy frameworks - good policies - played a critical role in bolstering the capacity of emerging markets to withstand the adverse consequences of these events. Improvements in monetary policy implementation and credibility have reduced reliance on foreign exchange (FX) interventions and capital flow management measures, and stricter macroprudential regulation also contributed to less FX interventions. Also, central banks have become less sensitive to fiscal interference and hold sway over domestic borrowing conditions. Looking ahead, countries with robust frameworks face easier policy trade-offs and are better positioned to navigate risk-off episodes. In contrast, economies with weaker frameworks risk de-anchoring inflation expectations and larger output losses if monetary tightening is delayed, especially when persistent price pressures emerge. In these settings, FX interventions offer only temporary relief and are less necessary when policy frameworks are sound.
abstract_zh: 近年来，新兴市场在风险规避时期展现出显著的韧性。尽管有利的外部环境——即"好运"——对此韧性有所贡献，但政策框架的改善——即"良政"——在增强新兴市场抵御此类事件负面冲击的能力方面发挥了关键作用。货币政策实施与可信度的提升降低了对外汇干预和资本流动管理措施的依赖，而更严格的宏观审慎监管也进一步减少了外汇干预。此外，各国央行对财政干预的敏感度降低，并掌握了国内借贷条件的主导权。展望未来，拥有健全政策框架的国家在面临更轻松的政策权衡时，能更好地应对风险规避时期。相比之下，政策框架薄弱的经济体若延迟货币紧缩，尤其是在持续价格压力出现时，将面临通胀预期脱锚及更大产出损失的风险。在此类情境下，外汇干预仅能提供暂时缓解，而当政策框架健全时，其必要性则显著降低。
title: Emerging Market Resilience: Good Luck or Good Policies?
title_zh: 新兴市场韧性：好运还是良策？

abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) regularly tap domestic and international capital markets through scheduled sovereign bond auctions. In this paper, we leverage a novel dataset covering over 75,000 sovereign issuance events and 20,000 securities from 20 EMEs between the early 2000s and 2023 to analyze the determinants of bond issuance choices, focusing on volume, maturity, and currency denomination. We find that local currency debt issuance is largely associated with refinancing needs, while foreign currency issuance reflects more strategic and cyclical considerations. In particular, foreign currency issuance correlates with global macroeconomic conditions, interest rate differentials, and investor sentiment. Our findings suggest that EME governments differentiate their debt management strategies based on the currency of issuance, with local currency issuance shaped by domestic budget mechanics and foreign currency issuance by external constraints and opportunities.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）通过定期主权债券拍卖，持续进入国内和国际资本市场。本文利用2000年代初至2023年间覆盖20个新兴市场经济体超过75,000次主权发行事件及20,000只证券的新数据集，分析债券发行选择的决定因素，重点关注发行规模、期限和货币计价。研究发现，本币债券发行主要与再融资需求相关，而外币债券发行则更多反映战略性和周期性考量。具体而言，外币债券发行与全球宏观经济状况、利率差异及投资者情绪存在关联。研究结果表明，新兴市场经济体政府会根据发行货币差异化其债务管理策略：本币发行受国内预算机制驱动，外币发行则受外部约束与机遇影响。
title: Determinants of Sovereign Bond Issuance in Emerging Markets
title_zh: 新兴市场主权债券发行的决定因素

abstract: Over the past two decades, many emerging market economies have become more resilient to external financial shocks. This paper assesses whether such resilience is broadly shared across emerging markets and developing economies by classifying them into three tiers based on economic size, income level, institutional strength, and financial integration. The analysis shows that first-tier emerging markets and developing economies have improved their external balance sheets and reduced dependence on official support. However, second- and third-tier emerging markets and developing economies have experienced growing external vulnerabilities since the global financial crisis, marked by rising external debt liabilities and declining foreign exchange reserves. Using a range of indicators, including sovereign defaults, arrears, partial defaults, and International Monetary Fund lending, the paper identifies episodes of external financial distress and shows that distress remains widespread among second- and third-tier emerging markets and developing economies. The empirical analysis confirms that key components of the net international investment position - especially external debt and foreign exchange reserves - predict the onset of external financial distress, with institutional quality shaping the impact. Weak institutions amplify risks, while strong institutions mitigate them. These findings highlight the importance of recognizing heterogeneity across emerging markets and developing economies, strengthening institutional quality alongside external balance-sheet management, and rebuilding buffers to safeguard against renewed global financial stress.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年，许多新兴市场经济体对外部金融冲击的抵御能力有所增强。本文根据经济规模、收入水平、制度实力和金融一体化程度，将新兴市场和发展中经济体分为三个层级，评估这种韧性是否广泛分布于各层级经济体。分析表明，第一层级新兴市场和发展中经济体改善了外部资产负债表，并减少了对官方支持的依赖。然而，自全球金融危机以来，第二和第三层级新兴市场和发展中经济体的外部脆弱性持续加剧，表现为外债负债上升和外汇储备下降。通过运用主权违约、拖欠、部分违约及国际货币基金组织贷款等一系列指标，本文识别了外部金融困境事件，并发现困境在第二和第三层级新兴市场和发展中经济体中依然普遍存在。实证分析证实，净国际投资头寸的关键组成部分——尤其是外债和外汇储备——能够预测外部金融困境的发生，而制度质量则影响这一作用机制。薄弱的制度会放大风险，而强大的制度则能缓解风险。这些发现凸显了认识新兴市场和发展中经济体异质性的重要性，强调了在加强外部资产负债表管理的同时提升制度质量，并重建缓冲以防范新一轮全球金融压力的必要性。
title: External Finance in Emerging Markets and Developing Economies: A Tale of Differences in Vulnerabilities
title_zh: 新兴市场与发展中经济体的外部融资：脆弱性差异的启示

abstract: Drawing on 100 million transactions, we show how speculators, hedgers, and market makers interact in the world's largest FX derivatives market, and that derivatives trading can affect exchange rates. Firms in the largest client sectors - pension and investment funds, insurers, and nonfinancials - use FX derivatives primarily to hedge currency risk, with dealer banks providing the liquidity. Hedge funds, with comparatively smaller net exposures, trade speculatively, whereas dealer banks insulate themselves from changes in speculative demand by taking offsetting positions with hedgers, especially nonfinancials. title: Topography of the FX Derivatives Market: A View from London
title_zh: 外汇衍生品市场的地形：来自伦敦的视角

abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一项衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场的新指标，估算了一条政策规则，该规则既考虑了其价格稳定目标的双重属性——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——也考虑了其操作框架的演变。内部传导方面：遵循教科书模式，但由于人民币和金融账户的积极管理而存在例外。外部溢出方面：国际溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应相当大。金融溢出效应属于次要层面，主要源于贸易溢出效应。

abstract: Business cycles are increasingly driven by global shocks, rather than the domestic demand shocks prominent in earlier decades, posing challenges for central banks seeking to meet domestic mandates and communicate their policy decisions. This paper analyzes the evolving influence and characteristics of global and domestic shocks in advanced economies from 1970-2024 using a new FAVAR model that decomposes movements in interest rates, inflation, and output growth into four global shocks (demand, supply, oil, and monetary policy) and three domestic shocks (demand, supply, and monetary policy). We find that the role of global shocks has increased sharply over time and that their characteristics differ from those of domestic shocks across multiple dimensions. Compared to domestic shocks, global shocks have a larger supply component, higher variance, more persistent effects on inflation, and are more asymmetric (contributing more to tightening than to easing phases of monetary policy). As global supply shocks have become more prominent, central banks have also been less willing to "look throughâ€ their effects on inflation than for comparable domestic shocks. The distinct characteristics and rising influence of global shocks-particularly global supply shocks-have significant implications for modeling monetary policy and designing central bank frameworks.
abstract_zh: 商业周期日益受到全球冲击的驱动，而非早期几十年中占据主导地位的国内需求冲击，这给寻求实现国内政策目标并传达其政策决策的中央银行带来了挑战。本文利用一种新的FAVAR模型，将利率、通胀和产出增长的变化分解为四种全球冲击（需求、供给、石油和货币政策）和三种国内冲击（需求、供给和货币政策），分析了1970-2024年发达经济体中全球与国内冲击的演变影响及特征。我们发现，全球冲击的作用随时间显著增强，且其特征在多个维度上与国内冲击不同。与国内冲击相比，全球冲击具有更大的供给成分、更高的方差、对通胀更持久的影响，并且更不对称（对货币政策紧缩阶段的贡献大于宽松阶段）。随着全球供给冲击日益突出，中央银行也更不愿意“忽略”其对通胀的影响，而相比之下对类似的国内冲击则更倾向于如此。全球冲击——尤其是全球供给冲击——的独特特征和日益增强的影响，对货币政策建模和中央银行框架设计具有重要启示。
title: Heaven or Earth? The Evolving Role of Global Shocks for Domestic Monetary Policy
title_zh: 天堂还是地狱？全球冲击对国内货币政策作用的演变

abstract: We consider a medium-scale macroeconomic model where the zero lower bound on interest rates remains binding permanently. We estimate the model for the Japanese economy, encompassing both active and passive fiscal policy scenarios. Our findings reveal a predominantly passive fiscal policy stance during the period spanning from 1995 to 2023. We compute fiscal multipliers for various policy instruments, showing that under the backdrop of passive fiscal policy: i) multipliers are lower than in an active fiscal policy regime; ii) government spending multipliers remain below one; iii) tax reductions can be associated with a decrease in output and inflation. A counterfactual analysis suggests that a more active fiscal policy would have resulted in a higher price level without increasing output volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个中等规模的宏观经济模型，其中利率零下限永久性具有约束力。我们利用日本经济数据对该模型进行估计，涵盖了积极与消极财政政策两种情景。研究结果表明，在1995年至2023年期间，日本主要采取消极财政政策立场。我们计算了不同政策工具的财政乘数，发现在消极财政政策背景下：（i）乘数低于积极财政政策体制；（ii）政府支出乘数始终小于1；（iii）减税可能导致产出与通胀下降。反事实分析表明，若采取更积极的财政政策，将实现更高的价格水平，且不会增加产出波动性。
title: Fiscal Policy in a Permanent Liquidity Trap: Evidence from Japan
title_zh: 永久流动性陷阱中的财政政策：来自日本的证据

abstract: We introduce the zero-one censored transformed normal (ZOC-TN) model for proportional responses with potential probability mass at the boundaries 0 and 1. The model combines a censored Gaussian variable with a two-parameter affine-logit transformation on the interior (0,1). We characterize the transformation parameters, establish large-sample properties, and relate the affine-logit specification to broader classes of interior distributions. Theoretical and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model can capture a wider range of qualitative density shapes than several benchmark models while remaining parsimonious, computationally efficient, and numerically stable. Furthermore, the ZOC-TN model can be extended (i) to account for nonlinearities and interactions in a tree-boosting machine learning framework and (ii) to explicitly model residual spatio-temporal variability. We apply the ZOC-TN model to loss given default (LGD) modeling for a large dataset of U.S. residential mortgages and compare it to multiple benchmark models. We find that a tree-boosted ZOC-TN model with a spatio-temporal frailty Gaussian process delivers the strongest out-of-sample performance, indicating that mortgage losses are shaped by nonlinear covariate effects and by unaccounted-for space-time variation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出零一截断转换正态（ZOC-TN）模型，用于处理边界0和1处可能存在概率质量的成比例响应数据。该模型将截断高斯变量与内部区间(0,1)上的双参数仿射对数比变换相结合。我们刻画了变换参数的特征，建立了大样本性质，并将仿射对数比设定与更广泛的内部分布类别联系起来。理论与实验结果表明，所提模型在保持简洁性、计算高效性和数值稳定性的同时，能够捕捉比若干基准模型更广泛的定性密度形态。此外，ZOC-TN模型可扩展至：（i）在树提升机器学习框架中纳入非线性和交互效应；（ii）显式建模残差的时空变异性。我们将ZOC-TN模型应用于美国住宅抵押贷款大样本数据的违约损失率（LGD）建模，并与多个基准模型进行比较。研究发现，结合时空脆弱性高斯过程的树提升ZOC-TN模型在样本外表现最优，表明抵押贷款损失受非线性协变量效应及未解释的时空变异共同影响。
title: A Censored Transformed Model for Proportional Outcomes with Boundary Mass and an Application to Loss Given Default Modeling
title_zh: 带边界质量的成比例结果的删失变换模型及其在违约损失率建模中的应用

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between AI adoption and carbon emission intensity. Using micro-level data from Chinese firms, we find that carbon intensity decreases following the adoption of AI. The effect is particularly pronounced among large firms, those headquartered in AI hubs, and those in high-carbon intensity sectors. We investigate several mechanisms and find that AI adoption is also associated with increases in energy management processes, green innovation, inventory efficiency, overall productivity, and the share of specialized labor. We find that AI-induced carbon reductions are subject to a large rebound effect of approximately 70%.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能应用与碳排放强度之间的关系。基于中国企业层面的微观数据，我们发现企业在采用人工智能后，其碳排放强度有所下降。这一效应在大型企业、总部位于人工智能枢纽的企业以及高碳排放强度行业的企业中尤为显著。我们研究了若干机制，发现人工智能应用还与能源管理流程、绿色创新、库存效率、整体生产率以及专业劳动力占比的提升相关。此外，我们发现人工智能带来的碳减排效应存在约70%的大幅反弹效应。
